File No. [印章: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. REGIST.R / 2445]
S.1, Special Branch Station
REPORT
Date July 4, 1933

Subject (in full) Reference the anonymous letter (attached) referring
to Chen Yung Zung and other in connection with the
activities of Hu Lih-fu.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by

A careful study of the file relating to Hu Lih-fu
(胡立夫) and the so-called Puppet Administration of Chapei
has been made but no mention of Chen Yung Zung (陈咏仁) was
discovered. If he was connected with Hu Lih-fu it was in
a very remote manner, as most of the names of Hu's henchmen
were obtained.
Enquiries show that Chen Yung Zung (陈咏仁) is a
salesman employed by Bohler Brothers & Co., Ltd., an Austrian
firm of steel manufacturers, who occupy offices at Room 318,
No.7 Peking Road, Telephone No.16061.
So far nothing has been learned which in any way
connects Chen Yung Zung with the Puppet Administration of
Chapei.

（印：FILE / O.C. I/C. S.B.）

Ben Golden
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期：1933年7月4日

事由（全称）：关于提及陈咏仁及其他人与胡立夫活动有关的匿名信（附后）。
由副督察长 Golder 制作 转呈

经仔细查阅有关胡立夫（Hu Lih-fu，胡立夫）及所谓闸北傀儡政权的档案，未发现提及陈咏仁（Chen Yung Zung，陈咏仁）的内容。若其与胡立夫有关联，则关系极为疏远，因为胡之大部分党羽的姓名均已掌握。
经查，陈咏仁（Chen Yung Zung，陈咏仁）系奥地利钢铁制造商博勒兄弟有限公司（Bohler Brothers & Co., Ltd.）的推销员，该公司办公地址位于北京路7号318室，电话16061。
截至目前，未发现任何将陈咏仁与闸北傀儡政权联系起来的线索。

（印：归档 / 特务科主管警官）

Ben Golden
副督察长

特务科主管警官。

Date April 10, 1932.
Date 29/4/32.

Subject (in full): Hwang Ching Yung's message to the Chapei Citizens
Maintenance Association intercepted by postal censors

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Tho. Robertson, Supt.

It is reported from an authentic source that a
reply dated April 4 from Hwang Ching Yung to Ju Lih Fu of
the Chapei Citizens Maintenance Association expressing his
support and sympathy with the organization has been intercepted
by postal censors
who, owing to the absence of the Woosung Shanghai Garrison
Commander, handed it to Wu Kai Sien of Kuomintang Headquarters.
The latter threatened to denounce Hwang Ching Yung to the
Nanking Government. Hwang was so much worried that he sent
Tang Ah Yu to see Wu Kai Sien in Room 57 of the Yih Ping
Shiang Hotel on April 6 endeavouring to redeem the document.
It is reported that Tang has succeeded in the mission but
how much he has paid for this letter is unknown.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,
Information.

O. i/c Sp. Br.
APR 11 1932

事由（全称）：邮政检查员截获黄景云致闸北市民维持会的信件

由谭绍良巡官制作 由 Tho. Robertson 巡官转呈

据可靠消息来源称，邮政检查员截获了黄景云于4月4日回复闸北市民维持会朱立夫（Ju Lih Fu，音译）的信件，信中表达了对该组织的支持与同情。由于吴淞上海卫戍司令缺席，检查员将该信移交给了国民党总部的吴凯先（Wu Kai Sien，音译）。后者威胁要向南京政府检举黄景云。黄十分担忧，遂于4月6日派遣唐阿玉（Tang Ah Yu，音译）前往亿平香酒店（Yih Ping Shiang Hotel，音译）57号房间会见吴凯先，试图赎回该文件。据报道，唐已成功完成使命，但为此封信支付了多少金额尚不清楚。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No. 3445
Headquarters Station,
12 10 32
Date October 12. 19 32

Subject (in full) Report on gambling at No. 108 North Szechuen Road.

Made by C. D. I. Nakagawa. Forwarded by

Enquiries made in connection with the gambling den
at No. 108 North Szechuen Road Extension show that it was
organized by a Chinese named Woo (吳) in conjunction with
another Chinese named Yang (揚). Both of them are living
in the French Concession. It is reported that the funds for
operating the place were furnished by Woo.

A Japanese named Hirayama was approached by both
these men to rent a house in his name. On the occasion of
the opening of the den, Hirayama received from Woo $250 which
he divided with his assistants named Teruo Yoshino and a
Chinese named Zau (曹), Yoshino receiving $100 and Zau $50.

T. Yoshino is of mixed Japanese and Chinese
extraction, his mother being Japanese.

Hirayama and Yoshino are now detained at the
Japanese Consulate for further enquiries.

Kyung Sah's Japanese name is Kenkichi Inouye and
he resides at No. 229 Darroch Road. He is a retired Major
of the Japanese Army and arrived here in January 1932.
Hirayama and Yoshino were once employed as agents for
furnishing general information. Inouye has no connection with
the gambling den.

The real name of one Jugi, mentioned in the attached
report of D.J.I. Palmer, is K. Washizaki. He was deported
from China on September 12 for the term of three years being
charged with fraud.

S. Nakagawa
C. D. I.
Supt. i/c Sec. C. 1.

(批：From Asst. C.P. Owers / Crim. B. / OCT 13 1932)
D.C. Crime Branch.

日期：1932年10月12日。

事由（全称）：关于四川北路108号赌博活动的报告。

由中川首席侦探督察制作。转呈

经查，四川北路延伸段108号的赌窟系由一名姓吴（Woo，吳）的华人与另一名姓杨（Yang，揚）的华人共同组织。两人均居住在法租界。据报道，经营该场所的资金由吴提供。

这两人接触了一名名叫平山（Hirayama）的日本人，以他的名义租赁房屋。在该赌窟开业之际，平山从吴处收到250元，他与名为吉野照雄（Teruo Yoshino）的助手及一名姓曹（Zau，曹）的华人进行了分赃，吉野得100元，曹得50元。

吉野照雄（T. Yoshino）是日华混血，其母亲为日本人。

平山和吉野目前被拘留在日本领事馆，以待进一步查问。

Kyung Sah 的日本名为井上健吉（Kenkichi Inouye），居住在达罗克路229号。他是日本陆军退役少佐，于1932年1月抵达此地。平山和吉野曾受雇为提供一般情报的代理人。井上与赌窟无关。

Palmer 副侦探督察所附报告中提到的 Jugi 的真实姓名为 Washizaki K.（鷲崎，音译）。他因被控欺诈，于9月12日被驱逐出中国，期限为三年。

S. Nakagawa（中川）
首席侦探督察
C. 1 科主管巡官。

Subject (in full) Report on gambling at 108 North Szechuen Road.

Made by D.S.I. Palmer. Forwarded by....................................................

Sir,
I beg to report that in connection with the above,
enquiries ascertained that private gambling in the form of
"Yan-tan " (摇滩), commenced at premises No.108 North Szechuen
Road, O.D.L., about 3 weeks ago, approximately 40 Chinese
attending. The premises are according to the name plate, the
staff quarters of the Ching Hwa Coy.
This den, or club, was conducted by a Japanese, whose
nom de plume is Kyung Sah (Chinese pronunciation), in conjunction
with a Cantonese named Woo (吴).
Between 8p.m. and 12 m.n., observation has been
maintained on the above premises since 1/10/32, but no persons
have been seen to enter or leave.
It was learned that the proprietors were endeavouring
to remove to premises in Wonglo Road and from discreet enquiries
in this vicinity, the following information was obtained from
C.P.W.196, employed on Park Terrace, Wonglo Road:- Shortly after
the cessation of hostilities, one Kwan Meu Hwa (管梅華), independent,
residing in the French Concession, instructed C.P.W.196 to
endeavour to rent his premises at No.23 Wonglo Road. With this
in view, the C.P.W. approached one Jugi, Japanese who resided
at 30 Wonglo Road but who has since, it is stated, been deported
to Japan for opening opium and gambling dens in Chapei. About
two months ago, the latter recommended a Japanese called Kyung
Sah, age about 60, wears Chinese clothes. This person informed
the watchman that he intended to form a company and desired to
rent No.23 Wonglo Road. The C.P.W. informed Kwan Meu Hwa (管梅華),
owner, and shortly afterwards a quantity of furniture arrived
at the above address. C.P.W.196 observed that amongst the

事由（全称）：关于四川北路108号赌博活动的报告。

由 Palmer 副侦探督察制作。转呈....................................................

先生，
谨此报告，就此事项经查实，约三周前，在四川北路108号（越界筑路区）的处所内开始了名为“摇滩”（Yan-tan）的私人赌博活动，约有40名华人参与。根据门牌显示，该处所为清华公司（Ching Hwa Coy.）的职员宿舍。
该赌窟或俱乐部由一名化名 Kyung Sah（中文发音）的日本人，与一名姓吴（Woo，吴）的广东人共同经营。

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL

September 28, 1932.

Sir,

I have to inform you that information has been received that public gambling comprising of a roulette wheel, etc., is being conducted on premises situated at Municipal No. 108, and Chinese No. 757, North Szechmen Road Extention, visiting card attached. The house in question is a foreign dwelling house, surrounded by a red brick wall with green painted gates leading to the North Szechmen Road, and is situated in Chinese territory, under the jurisdiction of the 1st Sub-Station, 5th Division of the Public Safety Bureau.

I should therefore be obliged if you would issue instructions that the above mentioned premises be raided and the gambling paraphernalia confiscated at your earliest convenience. The S.M.P. will render any assistance that is required.

Thanking you for your esteemed co-operation in this matter.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K M. Bourne.

THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, AUGUST 15, 1932

Police Arrest
Hu, Chapei
Puppet Head

Former Leader Denies
Charges Of Treason;
Says It Was Japanese
Idea And Not His

Admits Opium Dens
Were Established

Evidence May Lead To
Additional Arrests
By Police Of Chapei

The long city-wide hunt for the former "Chapei puppets", launched by the Bureau of Public Safety of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai was rewarded with the arrest of Mr. Hu Li-fu, short-lived ruler of Chapei, at Sinya Restaurant at corner of Jukong and North Szechuen Road at 7 o'clock Saturday evening.

During cross-examination at the bureau, Hu denied charges of treason. He admitted having organized the so-called Northern District Peace Preservation Committee, maintained a police force, collected taxes from Chapei merchants and residents, opened gambling and opium houses. The Japanese, he said, only suggested an idea, and he carried out the plan.

The testimony supplied clues which, Chinese police authorities believe, will lead to the arrest of all accomplices of Hu, among whom may be mentioned Wang Yu, one time vice-president of the Northern District Peace Preservation Committee, Chang Fu-ching, chief of police in Chapei, and Cheng Hai-chin, Yao Ya-chen, etc.

Named At Dinner

The address and activities of the head of the Chapei puppets were not disclosed until Saturday after noon when Inspector Hu ...

A squad of police inspectors and detectives headed by Police Officer Wu Hsiu-feng was at once despatched to the place. All the exits of the restaurant were placed under guard of the police, while Officer Wu, accompanied by two inspectors went upstairs. At the time of arrest, Hu was searched and found in possession of a pistol and 13 bullets.

Before Police Officer Lu Ying at the Bureau of Public Safety Saturday evening, Hu said that he started the organization of the Northern District Peace Preservation Committee in Chapei on March 24 upon the persuasion of one of his Japanese friends who urged him to assume the responsibility for the maintenance of good order in Chapei.

Moved By Pleadings

"At first," Hu continued, "I rejected the proposal. But moved by the pleadings of my Japanese friend that my fellow-countrymen living in Chapei had constantly suffered from the disturbances by Kiangpeh radicals, I finally acquiesced to start the organization on the condition that permission of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai should be secured in advance. Just as I was drafting a petition for such permission, the order for the arrest of myself and my colleagues was issued by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai."

Hu enumerated the activities with which his organization was engaged which included road-cleaning and the removal and burial of dead bodies. A police force of more than 100 men was organized out of recruits.

Removal Tax

As maintenance fund, Hu said that a tax of about 2 per cent on all articles removed in and out of Chapei by merchants and residents was collected. Income from this source, it was revealed, amounted to somewhere between $100 and $200 daily which, Hu said, was barely enough for the financing of his organization's work.

It was after some of the unscrupulous elements of his party, Hu continued, crept into the organization that its work began to draw unfavorable criticisms from the people which, Hu said, accounted for the closure of the office of the Northern District Peace Preservation Committee at Tien La Road in Chapei by order of the Japanese Military Headquarters.

The committee, however, subsequently removed its offices to Lin Fang Road, Hu said. Pressed for funds to continue its functions, opium and gambling estab...

警方逮捕
胡，闸北
傀儡头目

前领导人否认
叛国指控；
称这是日本人的
主意而非他的

承认鸦片烟馆
已设立

证据可能导致
闸北警方
进一步逮捕

大上海市公安局发起的对前“闸北傀儡”的全城搜捕行动取得了成果，周六晚上7点，在九江路与北四川路交界处的新雅酒家，逮捕了短命的闸北统治者胡立夫先生。

在公安局接受交叉审讯期间，胡否认了叛国指控。他承认组织了所谓的“北区治安维持会”，维持了一支警察部队，向闸北商人和居民征税，开设赌场和鸦片烟馆。他说，日本人只是提出了一个想法，而他执行了这一计划。

证词提供了线索，中国警方当局认为，这将导致逮捕胡的所有同伙，其中包括前北区治安维持会副会长王宇、闸北警察局长张福庆、程海金、姚亚臣等。

晚宴上被点名

直到周六下午，闸北傀儡头目的住址和活动才被披露，当时胡督察……

一支由警官吴秀峰率领的警督和侦探小队立即被派往该地。酒家的所有出口均由警察把守，而吴警官在两名警督的陪同下上楼。逮捕时，对胡进行了搜身，发现其持有一把手枪和13发子弹。

周六晚上，在公安局面对陆英警官时，胡表示，他是在一位日本朋友的劝说下，于3月24日开始在闸北组织北区治安维持会的，该朋友敦促他承担维护闸北良好秩序的责任。

被恳求所动

胡继续说：“起初，我拒绝了这一提议。但受我的日本朋友恳求的影响，他说居住在闸北的同胞不断遭受江北激进分子的骚扰，我最终同意在事先获得大上海市公署许可的条件下开始组建该组织。就在我起草申请此类许可的请愿书时，大上海市公署发布了逮捕我和我的同事的命令。”

胡列举了其组织从事的活动，包括道路清洁以及尸体的移除和埋葬。从招募的人员中组建了一支100多人的警察部队。

搬迁税

胡表示，作为维持基金，对商人和居民进出闸北的所有物品征收约2%的税款。据悉，来自这一来源的收入每天在100至200美元之间，胡称这仅够为其组织的工作提供资金。

胡继续说，在他党派的一些不法分子潜入该组织后，其工作开始引起民众的不利批评，胡称这导致了日军司令部下令关闭位于闸北天乐路的北区治安维持会办公室。

然而，胡表示，委员会随后将办公室迁至林芳路。由于缺乏继续运作所需的资金，鸦片和赌博场所……

Subject (in full) Opium Dens in Chapei.

Made by C.D.I. Nakagawa, Forwarded by

Sir,
I beg to report that acting under your instructions
I yesterday interviewed Inspector Okumura, Chief of the Judicial
Department of the Japanese Consular Police, in connection with
the attached confidential report on opium dens at present
operating in Chapei and made further enquiries as to the attitude
of the Japanese Military Authorities in this matter.
Inspector Okumura informed that owing to the imminence of
withdrawal of the Japanese troops from Shanghai, the Gendarmerie
have little or no time to attend to this matter and regret that
they cannot act on the information supplied by the S. M. P.
when the garrison duty has been transferred to the Chinese
Authorities the latter will automatically take the necessary
action.
Inspector Okumura further stated that the Gendarmerie have
no direct evidence of the fact that opium smoking is being
conducted in the premises mentioned in the attached file.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

Shanghai, May 5, 1932.

Sir,

I beg to report that five opium smoking dens
removed from French Concession to Chapei with the
gambling dens and the addresses are as follows:-

113 Tuh Zung Loo （德潤路）
4 opium benches and 4 pipes.
Sing Sing Zen（新新社）New Club.

121 Tuh Zung Loo. 3 opium pipes and 3 benches
Zuh Li Zen（日利社）which means daily
profitable club.

140 Ling Bing Loo （醜平路）
Thien Thien Zen（天天社）Daily Club.
3 opium pipes and 3 benches.

183 Tien Dong Loo （天同路）
3 opium pipes and 2 benches.

192 Tien Dong Loo （天同路）
2 opium pipes and 2 benches.

The first two above dens are on the opposite to
the Da Li Company-Gambling den-No. 118 Tuh Zung Loo,
the third one is at the back, and the last two are
on the opposite to another gambling den-Kyeu Fok Co.
No. 1 Zen Tuh Foong Alleyway （善德坊）Tien Dong
Loo, and their business are mostly from the opium
smokers of the gambling dens.

Many advertising cards have been issued by an
opium hong named San Shing （三興）at Tien Pao
Loo, （天寶路）to the smoking dens and opium will
be sold cheap to those who has the card issued. I
do not know if the opium has been sold or not
because I have not sent any one for it yet.

上海，1932年5月5日。

先生，

谨此报告，五家鸦片烟馆
已从法租界迁至闸北，
伴随赌场的迁移，地址如下：-

德润路113号 （德潤路）
4张鸦片榻和4根烟枪。
新新社（Sing Sing Zen）新俱乐部。

德润路121号。 3根鸦片烟枪和3张榻
日利社（Zuh Li Zen），意为每日
盈利俱乐部。

醜平路140号 （醜平路）
天天社（Thien Thien Zen）每日俱乐部。
3根鸦片烟枪和3张榻。

天同路183号 （天同路）
3根鸦片烟枪和2张榻。

天同路192号 （天同路）
2根鸦片烟枪和2张榻。

上述前两家烟馆位于大利公司赌场——德润路118号——的对面，
第三家在其后面，最后两家位于另一家赌场——久福公司
对面，地址为天同路善德坊1号 （善德坊）Tien Dong
Loo，其生意主要来自赌场吸烟者。

一家名为三興（San Shing）的鸦片行在天宝路
（Tien Pao Loo， （天寶路））向这些烟馆发放了许多广告卡，
持有发卡者可以廉价购买鸦片。我尚不知晓

page_data.en:
Inquires made that if the Japanese do take this part
of Chapei as a concession, the raw opium hongs will be
opened on or before the 16th. inst., and the opium tax
tax will be collected on the above date. The opium tax
for a smoking is $1.00 per day either a big or a small
one.
（批：ex-C.D.S.I. Yau Ts-Doo
Dennis forwarded
9.2.28.

Some Chinese said that the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai will take over the police authority on the
inst.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

A. B.

Confidential
Shanghai, 2nd. May, 1932.

Re: Opium and Gambling in Chapei.

Sir,

I beg to report that more than 20 good class smoking dens (house by house) in Tuh Zung Loo ( end of Chaoufoong Road) opposite to a big gambling den No: 118 Tuh Zung Loo. and 2 big opium hongs have been opened at Veh Wo Loo 物華路 about 10 houses length off the Settlement. (Chaoufoong Road, one is removed from French Concession and the other one is conducted by a man named Chang, brother-in-law of the proprietor, Portuguese subject, of Kwang Chong, 117 Yuen-fong Road, who sold his opium at 125 Yuenfong Road which was raided about five or six times by the Traffic Branch. He named his Hong as Doong Tai (同泰) and under the protection of Yau Ts-Doo, ex-C.D.S.I. of S.M.P., all the smoking dens round there have to buy opium from him.

There is a gambling den in a certain house at Chapei about 40 yards north of Urga Road brigde and the conductor named Siau San Mau who owned 26 public ricshas and also he was convicted with opium sale at Mukden Rd. at 1930. There is another big gambling den to be opened near the Doong Tai Opium Hong, Veh Wo Loo, and in which there are all kinds of gambling and opium smoking.

A series of conferences between the French Authorities and Doo Yoel. Sung for the gambling and opium in French Concession are expected to be favourable within this week and if the negotiations becomes deadlock, the gambling, opium hongs and smoking dens will be removed

（左侧手写批注：）
C.P.
Enquiries are being made
as to whether or not any of
these locations are being
kept purely for the
S.M. Police.
It would appear from
the premises similar
to those at Tuh
Zung Loo that they are
merely extensions of gambling
established & gambling
dens there.
D.C. (CRIME)
3 MAY 1932
DCp
3/4.

（底部手写批注：）
We must watch carefully & see whether
there is any reaction on this - & rectify
from this place.

上海，1932年5月2日。

事由：闸北的鸦片与赌博。

先生：

谨此报告，在土中路（兆丰路尽头）对面，即土中路118号的一家大型赌场附近，已开设了20余处高档烟馆（逐户分布）。此外，在距离租界约十幢房屋之遥的物华路（Veh Wo Loo），也开设了两家大型鸦片行。（其中一家是从法租界迁来的，另一家则由一名姓张的男子经营，此人是广忠洋行（Kwang Chong，位于元芳路117号）业主的妹夫，该业主为葡萄牙籍人士。此前，该业主在元芳路125号贩卖鸦片，该地点曾被警务处交通科突击搜查约五六次。此人将其鸦片行命名为“同泰”（Doong Tai），并在前工部局警务处刑事侦缉股督察长姚子斗（Yau Ts-Doo，音译）的庇护下，迫使周围所有烟馆均须向他购买鸦片。）

在闸北乌尔加路（Urga Road，音译）桥以北约40码处的某住宅内，有一家赌场，经营者名为萧三毛（Siau San Mau，音译），他拥有26辆公共人力车，并曾于1930年因在慕尔鸣路（Mukden Rd.）贩卖鸦片而被定罪。另有一家大型赌场即将在同泰鸦片行附近的物华路开业，该处提供各种形式的赌博及鸦片吸食服务。

预计本周内，法国当局与杜月笙就法租界内的赌博和鸦片问题举行的一系列会议将取得有利结果；如果谈判陷入僵局，这些赌场、鸦片行和烟馆将被迁移至

Subject (in full) Gambling in Chapei.

Made by C.D.I. Nakagawa, Forwarded by

Sir,

With reference to D.I. Thurgood's report dated May 2,
1932, on the subject of public gambling being conducted at the
Dah Lee Kung Sz Club, 118 Tuh Zung Road, Chapei, I beg to report
that I again called at the Japanese Consulate yesterday and
interviewed Inspector Okumura, Chief of the Judicial Department
of the Consular Police, for the purpose of ascertaining the
result of the action taken by the Japanese Military Authorities
in regard to this matter.

The undersigned was given to understand by Inspector Okumura
that the Japanese Gendarmerie are aware of the gambling but in
view of the imminence of their withdrawal from Shanghai and
consequent pressure of work in having to make arrangements for
departure, they did not propose to take any direct action
themselves, but, in all probability, they will convey the
necessary information to the Chinese Police at the time of
handing over of garrison duty in the district so that the latter
could deal with the matter in accordance with Chinese Law.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently,

Date May 5th 1932.
No. D 2443 / 32

Subject (in full) Shanghai Northern District Refugees Temporary
Preparatory Committee.

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson Supt.

With reference to the report appearing in
the May 4th issue of the Shun Pao, under the heading
of "Gambling Dens in Chapei" in which mention is made
of posters advertising gambling houses, opium houses,
brothels, etc., observations were carried out in Chapei
on May 4th but no advertisement directly or indirectly
referring to the said establishments could be seen.
There are, however, a number of so-called clubs now in
existence, the name boards of which have been placed
in conspicuous positions on the streets. It can
readily be believed that these clubs are not of a very
high order, especially when one takes note of the ante-
cedents of the Chinese concerning themselves with the
pseudo-administration of the Chapei area.
Hu Lih Fu (胡立夫), the leading light in the
administration of the Chapei district under the Japanese,
and a number of his confederates are evidently becoming
apprehensive regarding the rumoured re-establishment of
the Public Safety Bureau in areas now under Japanese
occupation, and in consequence called a meeting at the
office at 211 Yueh Zai Road between 5 and 6.30 p.m. on
May 4th, at which Hu Lih Fu presided and which was attended
by 10 members of the Committee. The following resolutions
were discussed and passed : -
1. That Chu Zing An (朱静) (proprietor of the Yuan Foong
Silk Filature, 399 Dixwell Road, O.O.L.) be assigned to
call upon the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to devise
with them a method of dealing with the Committee, should
the Municipality resume administration in Chapei.

事由（全称）上海闸北难民临时筹备委员会。

呈报人 D. S. 戈尔德 转呈人 托·罗伯逊（Tho Robertson） 警司。

关于5月4日《申报》刊登的题为“闸北赌窟”的报道中提及张贴广告招徕赌场、鸦片烟馆、妓院等事宜，5月4日在闸北进行了观察，但未见任何直接或间接提及上述场所的广告。然而，目前存在许多所谓的“俱乐部”，其招牌已放置在街道上显眼的位置。人们很容易相信这些俱乐部档次不高，尤其是考虑到那些参与闸北地区伪行政管理的中国人的背景。
胡立夫（Hu Lih Fu，胡立夫），作为日军统治下闸北区行政的核心人物，及其若干同伙，显然对传闻中将在目前日军占领区重建公安局一事感到担忧，因此于5月4日下午5时至6时30分之间，在岳载路211号的办事处召开了一次会议，由胡立夫主持，委员会10名成员出席。讨论并通过了以下决议：-
1. 指派朱静安（Chu Zing An，朱静）（欧陆路399号元丰丝厂业主）去拜访大上海市政府，以便在市政府恢复对闸北的行政管理时，与其商定处理委员会的方法。

EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
May 2, 1932.

Information Re Chapei.

Mr. Sokaka-wa, Sakumitsu and Tsugechi, employees of
the Japanese Consulate, and Hu Li Fu, Wong Dau and Zang
Gao Tsing have been discussing during the past few days
the preliminary measures for the organization of a Japanese
Concession in Shanghai.
Chapei, Kiangwan, Woosung, Paoshan, and Liho
will be considered as districts to which the Japanese
are immigrate.
A brothel with 14 Chinese prostitutes is located
in front of the Japanese Headquarters at No. 1036, Sin Kin
Road, Chapei.
Hu Li Fu on April 30 accepted the resignation of
Fong Tsung Yao, Chairman of the Chapei People's Self
Government Association, and has appointed Chu King Ai to
succeed him.
Since the bomb outrage in Hongkew Park, Japanese
motor-cycle patrols have been detailed for duty on the
streets from May 1.
Martial Law was enforced in Chapei from 8 p.m. to
4 a.m. but since April 30, Martial Law has been enforced
from 8p.m. to 6 a.m.

关于闸北的情报。

日本领事馆雇员 Sokaka-wa、Sakumitsu 和 Tsugechi，以及胡立夫（Hu Li Fu）、王道（Wong Dau）和臧高青（Zang Gao Tsing）在过去几天里一直讨论在上海组织日本租界的初步措施。
闸北、江湾、吴淞、宝山和梨园（Liho）将被视为日本人移民的地区。
一家拥有14名中国妓女的妓院位于闸北新景路1036号日本总部前方。
胡立夫（Hu Li Fu）于4月30日接受了闸北人民自治协会主席方宗耀（Fong Tsung Yao）的辞呈，并任命朱敬爱（Chu King Ai）继任。
自虹口公园炸弹袭击事件发生后，自5月1日起，日本摩托车巡逻队已被派往街道执勤。
闸北实行戒严令的时间为晚上8点至凌晨4点，但自4月30日起，戒严令实行时间为晚上8点至早上6点。

Refugees Rehabilitation Committee Meeting.

Made by......D. S. Golder................Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

Careful enquiries have been made in the vicinity
of the Offices of the above committee with a view to dis-
covering if possible the names and addresses of the persons
concerning themselves with the movement, however, said mem-
bers are apparently brooking no interference from outside
authorities and are keeping their names in the background.

Follows a report submitted by Agent No.6 who has
been assigned to this enquiry.

Seven members of the above mentioned committee
held a meeting in their office, 211 Yoeh Zai Road, Chapei,
between 3 and 4 p.m. April 30. Wu Lih Fu (胡立夫), reported
chairman of the Committee, presided. The following
resolutions were discussed and passed:-

1. That brothels in Chapei be allowed to commence operate
in May after their registration with this committee and
on payment of a fee ranging from $3 to $5 each house,
per mensem.

2. That opium smoking houses be also permitted to operate ON
from the same date on payment of a fee ranging from
$6 to $8 every two opium pipes per month.

3. That a "Chpaie District Brothels and Opium Control Office"
be established in the Committee office with Wu Lih-fu
as officer-in-charge to deal with collection of afore-
mentioned fees and conducting affairs regarding brothels
and opium.

4. That all cases of extortion on the part of loafers be
referred to the Japanese Military Police on Yoeh Zai
Road, Chapei.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（签名：D. S. Golder）
Commissioner of Police,
Sri, information.

以下是负责此项调查的第6号探员提交的报告。

上述委员会的七名成员于4月30日下午3时至4时之间，在位于闸北岳载路211号的办事处举行会议。据报道，委员会主席吴立夫（Wu Lih Fu，胡立夫）主持会议。讨论并通过了以下决议：-

Subject (in full) Chapei New Administration

Made by D.S. Gelder Forwarded by Thos Rubentam, Supt.

Since the formation of the so-called Shanghai Northern
District Refugees Relief Preparatory Committee with offices at
No.211 Yueh Zai Road, little or no information has been
obtained. As mentioned in my previous report the Committee
definitely refuse to see any member of outside authorities
other than Japanese and have conducted their meetings in
absolute secrecy. Continued rumour has it that gambling and
prostitution are being carried on under the aegis of this new
[puppet administration], this of course must have come to the
notice of the Japanese authorities, who however maintain that
there exists no authority other than that wielded by the
Japanese Naval and Military headquarters.

The following information regarding the latest meeting
of the committee comes from a source which in the PAST has
been quite reliable.

At No.211 Yueh Zai Road between 5 and 6.30 p.m. on
April 28th a meeting was held by the above committee which
was presided over by Hu Lih Fu the following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-

1. That a preparatory committee of seven be formed to undertake
the preparation for the formation of a volunteer corps.

2. That Hu Lih Fu, Yao Tsz-zai and Zang Ngoh-tsing be appointed
to a special committee to deal with offences committed by
the people of Chapei and that all serious offences be
referred to Dien Tsong Kai Chih, officer in charge of the
Ling Ping Road Headquarters of the Japanese Military Police.

3. That a manifesto be issued to notify the public to be
subject to the control of the volunteers.

4. That an investigation section of 20 detectives be established.

呈报人 D.S. Gelder 转呈人 Thos Rubentam，警司

自从所谓的“上海北区难民救济筹备委员会”在岳载路211号设立办事处以来，几乎未获得任何情报。正如我之前的报告所述，该委员会明确拒绝会见除日本人以外的任何外部当局成员，并以绝对保密的方式举行会议。持续有谣言称，在这个新的[傀儡政权]庇护下，赌博和卖淫活动正在开展，这当然必然已引起日本当局的注意，然而他们坚称，除了日本海军和军事总部所掌握的权力外，不存在其他任何权威机构。

以下关于该委员会最近一次会议的情报来自一个过去相当可靠的消息源。

4月28日下午5时至6时30分之间，上述委员会在岳载路211号举行了一次会议，由胡立夫（Hu Lih Fu，音译）主持，讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 成立一个由七人组成的筹备委员会，负责组建志愿团的准备工作。

2. 任命胡立夫（Hu Lih Fu，音译）、姚子哉（Yao Tsz-zai，音译）和臧鄂清（Zang Ngoh-tsing，音译）组成一个特别委员会，处理闸北民众犯下的罪行，所有严重罪行均移交负责灵平路日本宪兵队总部的 Dien Tsong Kai Chih（音译）军官处理。

3. 发布宣言，通知公众服从志愿团的管制。

4. 建立一个由20名侦探组成的调查科。

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

At 4 p.m. on April 22nd 10 members of the Shanghai
Northern District Refugees Rehabilitation Committee held a
meeting at their office at No.211 Yueh Zai Road, Chapei,
when they discussed and passed the following resolutions :-
1. That branch committees of the movement be organized at
Kiangwan, Chapei and Woosung.
2. That a volunteer corps be organised to maintain peace
and order in the devastated areas.
3. That Chu Zing An (朱静庵), owner of a silk filature
at No.399 Dixwell Road and a member of the Chinese Silk
Filature Owners Guild, 578 North Shanse Road, be
appointed chief of the Volunteer Corps.
It is not known whether Hu Lih Fu was present at
this meeting, he is however known to be concerning himself
with the formation of the new administration.
At the conclusion it was decided to hold another
meeting in the near future to which a greater number of
persons should be called. This meeting was set for 2 p.m.
on April 23rd and took place in the offices of the association
at No.211 Yueh Zai Road. About 30 persons attended all armed
with a letter previously sent to them by the committee. Hu
Lih Fu and Chu Zing An were present. After some discussion
the committee passed the following resolutions :-
1. That as no replies had been received to letters addressed
to the Chinese Authorities and the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce calling for recognition of the Committee, a
further meeting should be held on April 27th at 2 p.m.
to discuss the matter.
2. That Fong Tseng-yao (方正耀) former chief of the

Made by D.S.I. Willgoss. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
On the 18th April, 1932, Mr. Wong Si Chi, one of the senior
Chinese employees of the Henningsen Produce Co., 1512 Sawgin Road,
received a letter, a translation of which is below.
Mr. Wong attended the meeting and when asked to sign a register
he refused to do so, stating that he was not attending the meeting
in an official capacity, but out of curiosity.
The letter was handed to Inspt. Groves by Mr. Wong on the
morning of the 23rd April, 1932, and has since been returned to
Mr. Wong.
"Dear Mr. Si Chi,
We beg to inform you that after the recent
war in Chapei, we realize it is necessary to have the adminis-
tration of the market, public safety, traffic and public health
restored to normalcy. There are many important problems re the
sovereignty of Chapei for us to solve. We cannot expect to
achieve success without cooperation. We understand that you
are able to direct and hope that you will kindly come over to
attend a meeting to be held at 2 p.m. 20-4-32. We are looking
forward immensely for your valuable advice and hoping that you
will not decline to be present.
Chopped :-
The Provisional Rehabilitation
Committee of the Chapei Refugees,
Shanghai.
P.S.
This letter will admit the bearer to enter after signing
his name. No admittance allowed without this letter."
On envelope.

王先生出席了会议，当被要求在登记簿上签名时，他拒绝了，声称他并非以官方身份出席会议，而是出于好奇。
1932年4月23日上午，王先生将这封信交给了格罗夫斯（Groves）巡官，此后该信已退还给王先生。
“尊敬的雪儿先生：
谨此告知，鉴于近期闸北战事，我们认识到有必要使市场管理、公共安全、交通和公共卫生恢复正常。关于闸北主权的问题有许多重要问题需要我们要解决。若无合作，我们无法期望取得成功。我们知道您具有领导能力，希望您能光临参加于32年4月20日下午2时举行的会议。我们极其期待您的宝贵建议，并希望您不要拒绝出席。
盖章：-
上海闸北难民临时善后委员会。
附言：
此信允许持信人在签名后进入。无此信不得入内。”
写在信封上。

April 27, 1932.

MISCELLANEOUS

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

THE MODEL JAPANESE CHAPEI ADMINISTRATION.

After the Japanese occupation of Chapei, a number
of Chinese traitors under the direction of the Japanese formed
the puppet organization known as the "Chapei District Citizens
Maintenance Association," under which name, these traitorous
Chinese conducted vicious acts of every description and
engaged in extortion of the people. The public became
dissatisfied with the foul tactics of these traitors, so
the Japanese dissolved the association. However, in spite
of this, the Japanese surreptitiously continue in their
determination to gain their object.
These Chinese traitors have again become active
and are preparing to organise another puppet administrative
organ for the Chapei district. They are keeping all their
preparations secret and, on that account, very little
information is obtainable. Our reporter who has been
enquiring into this matter reports the following :-
After the Japanese dissolved the "Chapei District
Citizens Maintenance Association," Wu Lih Fu, Wang Doo and
other traitorous leaders received continuous support from
the Japanese and, acting in accordance with instructions of
these latter, organised the so-called "Chapei Refugee
Provisional Relief Association," the premises of which are
located on Ling Ping Road. The underhand tactics of this
association are similar to those of the first one formed by
them, and the only difference is the new name for the bogus
organization.
According to information received from reliable
sources, the so-called "Chapei Refugee Provisional Relief
Association" is now known as the "Shanghai Chapei District
Citizens Self-Government Progress Association" and it is
still under the leadership of Wu Lih Fu, Wang Doo and others;
but supported by the Japanese. The bulk of the lesser
important members of this Association are notorious bad
characters of the former Chapei district.
Opium and gambling dens and houses of prostitutes,
etc. are to be found everywhere in the Chapei district.
Investigations conducted by our reporter show that three big
gambling dens exist in Chapei, i.e., the Yuen Foh Company,
situate in a certain house in the Poo Chuen Li alleyway off
Jukong Road; the Club of the Dah Li Company, situate in a
certain house in the Tuh Zung Li alleyway off Ling Ping Road;
the Kiu Wu Company. Of these three dens, the second one
is well supplied with opium, gambling and prostitutes are
special features. It is reported that this Club pays
tribute money to the amount of $300 daily to the Japanese
military authorities for purposes of protection.
At 2 p.m. April 25, the members of this traitorous
"Chapei District Citizens Self-Government Progress Association"
held a meeting in a house at the intersection of the Chinese
controlled territory and the Settlement and drew up a number
of rules for the collection of unjust taxes. At present,
they are engaged in devising schemes for the establishment of
a Hwa Hwei Lottery, public sale of opium and to permit
prostitution.

杂项

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

模范日本闸北行政机构。

日军占领闸北后，一批汉奸在日本人的指使下成立了名为“闸北区市民维持会”的傀儡组织，这些汉奸以此名义进行了各种恶行，并向民众敲诈勒索。公众对这些汉奸的卑劣手段感到不满，因此日本人解散了该协会。然而，尽管如此，日本人仍在暗中继续决心实现其目标。
这些汉奸再次活跃起来，正准备为闸北区组织另一个傀儡行政机构。他们将所有准备工作保密，因此可获得的情报很少。一直在此事上进行调查的本报记者报告如下：-
在日本人解散“闸北区市民维持会”后，吴立夫（Wu Lih Fu，音译）、王杜（Wang Doo，音译）和其他汉奸头目持续得到日本人的支持，并按照后者的指示，组织了所谓的“闸北难民临时救济协会”，其址位于灵平路。该协会的幕后手段与他们成立的第一个协会类似，唯一的区别是这个虚假组织的新名称。
据可靠消息来源称，所谓的“闸北难民临时救济协会”现在被称为“上海闸北区市民自治促进会”，仍由吴立夫（Wu Lih Fu，音译）、王杜（Wang Doo，音译）等人领导；但得到日本人的支持。该协会的大部分次要成员都是原闸北区臭名昭著的坏人。
鸦片馆、赌窟和妓院等在闸北区随处可见。本报记者进行的调查显示，闸北存在三大赌窟，即：位于菊康路宝泉里某弄堂某号的元福公司；位于灵平路图宗里某弄堂某号的大利公司俱乐部；以及九舞公司（Kiu Wu Company，音译）。在这三个赌窟中，第二个鸦片供应充足，赌博和妓女是其特色。据报道，该俱乐部每天向日本军方支付300美元的保护费。
4月25日下午2时，这个叛国的“闸北区市民自治促进会”成员在华界与租界交界处的一所房屋内举行会议，制定了一系列征收苛捐杂税的规则。目前，他们正策划建立华惠彩票、公开贩卖鸦片以及允许卖淫的方案。

登记。请同时附上。JM
32年4月27日

REPORT
Date April 22, 1942.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Northern District Refugees Rehabilitation Preparatory Committee, previously known as the Shanghai Northern district Citizens Maintenance Association.

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Jhv Robertson Supt.

On the afternoon of April 20th a visit was paid to the offices of the above committee which are situated at No.211 Yueh Zai Road off Ling Ping Road, Chinese Territory, and to the north of Kungping Road.

Although the Chinese in the outer office of the above address was told that the visit was of a friendly nature, he returned from the office of the Chinese in Charge which was situated somewhere in the upper regions of the building, stating that the office, nor its business had anything to do, nor any connection with the Settlement and that the person in charge would see no one except Chinese who were intending to return to the areas now under Japanese occupation. Careful note was taken of the, some 20, Chinese who were lounging about in the outer office, but none of those previously connected with the North District Citizens Maintenance Association were observed. Immediately opposite from the office at 211 Yueh Zai Road the Japanese naval landing party have established an office or post, on the premises of a Chinese School.

A few enquiries were made of Chinese living in the vicinity, but no information could be obtained, the majority of them did not even know of the existence of an office at No.211 Yueh Zai Road.

In view of the secret manner in which the office at No.211 Yueh Zai Road was being conducted, it was apparent that any further open visit on the part of the undersigned would be of no practical use, and an agent of the Special Branch was, therefore, instructed to obtain the necessary information.
(Follows a report submitted by Agent No.6)

日期：1942年4月22日。

主题（全称）：上海北区难民善后筹备委员会，前身为上海北区市民维持会。

呈报人：D. S. Golder 转呈人：Jhv Robertson 警司

4月20日下午，本人造访了上述委员会的办事处，该处位于华界临平路旁岳载路211号，公平路以北。

尽管已告知上述地址外间办公室的一名华人，此次访问性质友好，但他从位于楼上某处的负责人办公室回来后表示，该办事处及其业务与租界毫无关系或牵连，且负责人除有意返回目前日军占领区的华人外，不见任何人。本人仔细记录了在外间办公室闲荡的大约20名华人，但未发现此前与北区市民维持会有任何关联的人员。在岳载路211号办事处正对面，日本海军陆战队在一所华校校舍内设立了一个办事处或哨所。

本人向附近居住的华人进行了一些询问，但未能获得任何信息，大多数人甚至不知道岳载路211号设有办事处。

鉴于岳载路211号办事处的运作方式隐秘，显然本人若再进行公开访问将无实际用处，因此指示特别部门的一名密探去获取必要的情报。
（随后附上第6号密探提交的报告）

is highly probable that the meeting referred to in the penul-

Citizens Maintenance Association.

Made by.......D.S. Golder................Forwarded by Thos Robertson Supt

During the afternoon of April 19th it was the in-
tention of the undersigned to pay a further visit to the
offices of the Shanghai Northern District Citizens Maintenance Association, Ming
Li Road.

Upon arrival at the Chapei side of the Markham Road
Bridge, however, the party which was proceeding in the Special
Branch (Police-car) were stopped by Japanese blue-jackets, who
on learning the business of the occupants of the car, directed
them to proceed to the Chapei (District) Headquarters of the
Japanese landing party, 1036 Sing Ming Road. There the party
were conveyed to the office of the officer i/c. He upon being
informed of the object of the visit explained at some length
that the association under report were abolished by order of
the Japanese Chief of Staff and have not since functioned.
He assured us that the premises at Ming Li Road had been
closed and the Chinese in office were ejected and ordered to
cease their operation forthwith. He denied emphatically the
report that persons concerned with Shanghai Northern District
Citizens Maintenance Association, had been re-employed in any
new association whose supposed aims were the rehabilitation
of the wasted Chapei area.

Careful watch was made whilst passing the Chapei
area for posters emanating from any of the associations but
none were found. The only efforts to maintain peace and order
appear to be frequent Japanese blue-jacket patrols and armed
posts. About half a mile north of the Settlement boundary
workmen of the Chapei Electricity Company or Telephone Company
were seen impairing overhead cables. For the past few days
efforts have been made to get into touch with the proprietor

4月19日下午，本人原计划再次造访位于明理路的上海北区市民维持会办事处。

然而，当到达马克姆路大桥的闸北一侧时，乘坐特别部门（警车）前行的小组被日本水兵拦下。日本水兵在得知车内人员的来意后，指示他们前往位于星明路1036号的日本陆战队闸北（区）总部。在那里，小组被带到负责人的办公室。负责人在获悉访问目的后，详细解释说，本报告所涉协会已根据日本参谋长的命令被废除，此后不再运作。他向我们保证，明理路的 premises（场所/房屋）已关闭，办公的华人已被驱逐，并被命令立即停止活动。他坚决否认有关上海北区市民维持会的相关人员受雇于任何新协会的报道，据说该新协会的目标是重建遭受破坏的闸北地区。

在经过闸北地区时，本人密切留意是否有来自任何协会的海报，但未发现任何海报。维持和平与秩序的唯一努力似乎表现为频繁的日本水兵巡逻队和武装哨所。在租界边界以北约半英里处，可以看到闸北电力公司或电话公司的工人正在损坏架空电缆。过去几天里，本人一直试图联系

Eastern Times:-

THE CHAPEI ADMINISTRATION.

During the past few days, the local newspapers
have reported the dissolution of the Chapei puppet government
by the Japanese marines authorities and the information of a
new administration with a new office in No. 66 Kin Lih Road.

A reporter of the Tuo Yan News Agency, who called
at the above address to investigate, noticed several plainclothes
Japanese searching male pedestrians, while a number of Japanese
marines were posted at various points along the roads. Three
marines were on guard at No. 66 Kin Lih Road. Tsz Lih Chen, Lee
Dou Ching, and the captain of the 1st company. Persons who wish
to get passes must first apply to the Bureau at No. 66
Kin Lih Road.

With the exception of a change in the address
to the old premises of the 5th Division Public Safety Bureau
near Kin Lih Road, Shian Yen Jao, Hung Chen, there are no changes
in the old organization. This office is under the Charge of Wu
Lih Fu with Zung Shee Tsz and others as assistants. Yaung Doo has
resigned.

闸北行政机构。

在过去几天里，当地报纸报道了闸北傀儡政府被日本海军陆战队当局解散，并在锦里路66号的新办公室组建新行政机构的消息。

托延新闻社的一名记者前往上述地址调查时，注意到几名便衣日本人在搜查男性行人，而多名日本海军陆战队员则部署在沿路的各个要点。锦里路66号有三名陆战队员站岗。子力臣（Tsz Lih Chen）、李斗清（Lee Dou Ching）以及第一连连长。希望获得通行证的人必须首先向锦里路66号的局里申请。

除了地址变更为位于锦里路附近的原第五分局公安局旧址（咸仁桥、洪镇）外，原有组织没有任何变化。该办公室由吴立夫（Wu Lih Fu）负责，宗世慈（Zung Shee Tsz）等人担任助理。杨杜（Yaung Doo）已辞职。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, April 16, 1932

Chinese Regime
In Chapei Again
Opening Offices

Branch Of Maintenance
Association Started
At Woosung

ALLEGED CHINESE
SOLDIERS NABBED

Settlement Residents
Invited To Support
North Area Organ

The Chinese political regime organized on April 1 in the Chapei areas under Japanese military control and dissolved at the order of Japanese Naval authorities on April 11 is again in existence today, though under different leaders.

A preparatory office of the re-organized Chapei Citizens Maintenance Association was opened yesterday at 214 Yuen Zai Road near Lingping Road. This morning this office was removed to 66 Ming Lih Road.

New Officials Sought
Although no announcement has yet been made by the reorganized association as to who will be its officials, it is known that several well known Chinese residents of the International Settlement and the French Concession have been invited to lend their support and influence to the venture.

The majority of the employees of the organization dissolved by Japanese authorities last week are connected with the reorganized association and are already on duty.

Woosung Branch Opened
Members of the clerical staff of the first regime have been retained and are at work at the new headquarters. The bureau heads and the chairman of the former association have not returned to office.

Fifty-four policemen, eight clerks and four special investigators in the employ of the Chapei Citizens Maintenance Association were sent to Woosung yesterday to establish a branch of the Chapei organization.

Policemen Unarmed
As the majority of houses in Chapei were destroyed during the fighting a number of straw shacks have been erected to accommodate those who can be persuaded to return to the area. Farmers in the vicinity around Woosung are working in their fields, but the completeness of destruction in the city has retarded the return to normalcy.

Policemen employed by the Chapei Association are unarmed and are garbed in blue cloth uniforms. The investigators act in the capacity of plainclothes men. They are stationed at the entrances to Chapei to assist in the searching of people and to check on property brought in or taken from the area.

Anti-Chinese handbills purporting to emanate from the propaganda department of the "Shanghai Citizens Self-Strong Association" were scattered from a motor-car travelling along Pingliang Road last night. The bills urged Chinese to oppose the schemes of militarists and to work for the control of the Shanghai area by civilians.

Two Chinese, believed to be soldiers, were arrested on Whangpoo Road within a few yards of the Japanese consulate general compound last night. The first man was found about 9.15 p.m. and taken into custody by a Japanese constable. Between midnight and one o'clock this morning the constable on duty arrested a second Chinese.

Both prisoners were subsequently turned over to Hongkew Station. They are being held pending the outcome of a joint investigation by Municipal Police and Japanese authorities.

（批：S.L. Please note and pass W. Reg.
Wallace White.

18.4.32.）

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1932年4月16日，星期六

中国政权
再次出现在闸北
开设办事处

维持会分会
在吴淞成立

涉嫌中国
士兵被捕

邀请租界居民
支持北区机构

由日本军方控制下的闸北地区于4月1日组建、并于4月11日奉日本海军当局命令解散的中国政治政权，今日再次存在，尽管领导人已更换。

重组后的闸北市民维持会筹备处于昨日在灵平路附近的元宰路214号开设。今晨，该办事处已迁至明立路66号。

寻求新官员
虽然重组后的协会尚未宣布其官员人选，但据悉，几位国际租界和法租界的知名中国居民已受邀为这一举措提供支持和影响力。

上周被日本当局解散的该组织的大部分雇员都与重组后的协会有联系，并且已经上岗。

吴淞分会开业
第一个政权的部分文书工作人员被留用，并在新总部工作。前协会的局长和主席尚未复职。

昨天，受雇于闸北市民维持会的54名警察、8名文员和4名特别调查员被派往吴淞，以建立闸北组织的分会。

警察未携带武器
由于闸北的大部分房屋在战斗中被毁，已搭建了一些草棚，以容纳那些被说服返回该地区的人。吴淞周边的农民正在田间劳作，但城市遭受的彻底破坏阻碍了正常生活的恢复。

闸北协会雇佣的警察未携带武器，身着蓝色布制服。调查员便衣行事。他们驻守在闸北入口处，协助搜查人员，并检查带入或带出该地区的财产。

昨晚，一辆沿平凉路行驶的汽车散发了据称出自“上海市民自强会”宣传部的反华传单。传单敦促中国人反对军阀的阴谋，致力于由平民控制上海地区。

昨晚，两名被认为是士兵的中国人在黄浦路日本总领事馆大院附近几码处被捕。第一人于晚上9点15分左右被发现，并由一名日本巡捕拘押。在今日凌晨午夜至一点之间，值班巡捕逮捕了第二名中国人。

两名囚犯随后被移交给虹口捕房。他们正被羁押，等待工部局警务处与日本当局联合调查的结果。

（批注：S.L. 请知悉并转交 W. Reg.
华莱士·怀特 (Wallace White)。
JAS
1932年4月18日。）

Translation of French Report dated April 7, 1932

An Association for the upholding of the present state of affairs
has been organised in Chapei.

An independent municipality with the title "Association
for the Maintenance of the Situation in Chapei" is being
organised, under the auspices of the Japanese Authorities, at
66 Min Lin Lou, Chapei, formerly the office for the collection
of taxes of the Finance Bureau of Greater Shanghai.
The President of this Association is one HU LI FOU
(          ), age 52 years, native of Kiangpei.
This Association has a book-keeping department, a
correspondence bureau and a secretariat. Eighty employees
have been engaged. Two armed Japanese soldiers are on duty
at the door.

The organisation of a Police Force is being proceeded with.
The Chief of Police is one ZANG GNO TSING (          ), native of
Kiangpei, who is the proprietor of the Dah Kueu Yuen Bath House,
260 Sinza Road. The Police is comprised of two branches : a
traffic branch and an investigation department. In charge of
the Traffic Office is one ZENG ZENG KIE (          ), alias FI
LONG AH KENG (          ), former proprietor of the Fi Long Garage,
Cnekiang Road, a naturalised Portuguese. The Chief of the
Investigation Bureau, which is staffed with four detectives, is
one Yao Tze Zeu (          ), alias AH SENG (          ), who was
formerly a detective in the International Settlement Police.
Each detective is paid 35 to 40 dollars. There are about twenty
constables in the Police Force. They wear khaki uniform. The
pay of each constable has been fixed at 18 dollars. At present
these constables are on the premises of the Association and will
be posted in the streets of Chapei, as soon as the preparations
of the Organisation are completed. In addition to keeping order
in the streets they have to serve as interpreters between
Chinese and Japanese.

According to the President of this Independent
Municipality, the strength of the Force will be increased to
2,000, with the least possible delay.
The inhabitants may not remove. Those who desire to
transport goods must first notify the "Municipality", which
estimates the value of the goods and issues a pass. A tax of
2/1000 of the value of the goods is collected.
Owners of boats and vehicles of all kinds are called
upon to pay a tax to the said municipality from April 1.
Notices announcing the date of the operation of the
Association in question were pasted up in the roads on April 4.
On April 6 the "Association for the Maintenance of the
Situation at Chapei" signed on some fifty coolies for the
cleaning of the streets.
These coolies, as well as the other employees of the
"Municipality" are provided with a rectangular badge, bearing
the following characters (          ), translation of which is
"Association for the Maintenance of the Situation in Chapei".
The Japanese Authorities, moreover, published the
following official statement :-
"The Japanese Authorities have never sought to set up, nor
given assistance to set up a political or administrative form
of government whatever, at Chapei. The Japanese occupation has
confined itself to military necessities, at the same time
considering it desirable that the Police be reorganised, in
order to ensure that order and the circulation of the traffic
be maintained.
Furthermore, as negotiations are in progress, for the
cessation of Sino-Japanese hostilities, the Japanese Authorities
have, up to the present, been content to await the results of
the negotiations, while keeping the situation under observation.
However, they have never seen, and do not now see, the
necessity to obstruct an organisation movement attempted by
bona fide Chinese personalities."

1932年4月7日法语报告译文

闸北已成立一个维持现状的协会。

一个名为“闸北局势维持会”的独立市政机构正在日本当局的赞助下组建，地点位于闸北明林楼66号，原为大上海财政局征税办公室。
该协会主席为胡立夫 (HU LI FOU) (          )，52岁，江北人。
该协会设有会计科、通信局和秘书处。已雇用八十名员工。门口有两名武装日本士兵执勤。

正在组建一支警察部队。警察局长为 ZANG GNO TSING (          )，江北人，是新闸路26号大桂园浴室的业主。警察部队由两个分支组成：交通科和调查科。交通办公室主任为 ZENG ZENG KIE (          )，别名 FI LONG AH KENG (          )，前浙江路飞龙汽车行业主，归化葡萄牙籍。调查局局长由四名侦探组成，负责人为 Yao Tze Zeu (          )，别名 AH SENG (          )，前国际租界警务处侦探。每名侦探薪水为35至40元。警察部队中约有二十名巡捕。他们身穿卡其色制服。每名巡捕的薪俸定为18元。目前这些巡捕在协会驻地，一旦组织准备工作完成，将被部署到闸北街道。除了维持街道秩序外，他们还必须担任中日之间的翻译。

据这个独立市政机构的主席称，警力将尽快增加到2000人。
居民不得搬迁。那些希望运输货物的人必须首先通知“市政当局”，后者评估货物价值并发放通行证。征收货物价值千分之二的税款。
各类船只和车辆的所有者被要求从4月1日起向上述市政机构缴纳税款。
宣布该协会运营日期的告示于4月4日张贴在道路上。
4月6日，“闸北局势维持会”签约雇佣了约五十名苦力清扫街道。
这些苦力以及“市政当局”的其他员工都配有一枚长方形徽章，上面印有如下字符 (          )，译为“闸北局势维持会”。
此外，日本当局发表了以下官方声明：
“日本当局从未寻求在闸北建立任何形式的政治或行政政府，也未提供援助。日本的占领仅限于军事需要，同时认为重组警察部队是可取的，以确保维持秩序和交通畅通。
此外，由于中日敌对行动停止的谈判正在进行中，日本当局迄今为止一直满足于等待谈判结果，同时观察局势。
然而，他们过去没有，现在也不认为有必要阻碍由真诚的中国人士尝试的组织运动。”

位于闸北明利路66号的上海北区市民维持会于4月10日招募了更多警察，使警察总数增至约110人。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3445.
Date 11. 4. 38

CHAPEI DISPLAYING
NEW ACTIVITY
Number Of Residents
Have Returned To
Some Areas

According to reports from
Chapei, the district is again the
hub of human activity and stalls
have appeared in several streets
for the sale of vegetables, fish and
rice. Crossing over Markham Road
Bridge into Heng Fong Road could
be seen a number of stalls, giving
the street the appearance of a
market. Chinese police officers in
new khaki uniforms carrying
batons and white cloth arm-bands
were observed everywhere, keeping
law and order.

According to one report, the
Chapei District Citizens' Main-
tenance Association has claimed
that no unfair taxes would be
imposed and that in no case would
it exceed three per cent of the
value of any goods. The association
has emphasized the necessity of
the collection of taxes to meet the
expenses connected with policing
and generally looking after the
district.

It was learnt that foreign goods
are exempt from taxation, but that
Chinese who attempt to evade
payment of taxes by passing off
their goods as foreign-imported
would be dealt with severely.

Officials of the association have
declared that the warrants issued
for the arrest by the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai were unjustifi-
able as the sole purpose of the
association was to look after pro-
perty in Chapei and minimize the
losses sustained by Chapei re-
sidents following the outbreak of
hostilities.

They have expressed the will-
ingness to hand over control of
the association to the Mayor of
the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai. They further stated that
they would assist silk filatures
and other mills to resume opera-
tions by affording them adequate
police protection, and have in-
vited the Municipal Council to
send representatives to Chapei to
investigate conditions there.

（批：SI, Please see and attach while
on this subject.

编号 D 3445。
日期 1938年4月11日

闸北呈现
新活动
部分区域
居民回流

据来自闸北的报告，该地区再次成为人类活动的中心，几条街道上出现了售卖蔬菜、鱼类和大米的摊位。穿过麦高包路（Markham Road）桥进入恒丰路，可以看到许多摊位，使这条街呈现出市场的景象。随处可见身穿新式卡其色制服、手持警棍并佩戴白布臂章的中国警察在维持治安。

据一份报告称，闸北区市民维持会声称不会征收不公平的税款，且任何货物的税率绝不会超过其价值的百分之三。该协会强调，为了支付与警务及一般地区管理相关的费用，征税是必要的。

据悉，外国商品免税，但对于试图将本国货物冒充为进口外国货以逃税的中国人，将予以严厉处置。

该协会官员宣称，大上海市政府签发的逮捕令是不合理的，因为该协会的唯一目的是保护闸北的财产，并尽量减少敌对行动爆发后闸北居民遭受的损失。

他们表示愿意将该协会的控制权移交给大上海市政府市长。他们进一步表示，将通过提供充分的警力保护，协助缫丝厂和其他工厂恢复运营，并邀请工部局派遣代表前往闸北调查当地情况。

（批注：SI，请阅知并在处理此事时附上。
D.S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3445
Translation of French Report dated April 7, 1932
Date 21/4/32

An Association for the upholding of the present state of affairs
has been organised in Chapei.

An independent municipality with the title "Association
for the Maintenance of the Situation in Chapei" is being
organised, under the auspices of the Japanese Authorities, at
66 Min Lih Lou, Chapei, formerly the office for the collection
of taxes of the Finance Bureau of Greater Shanghai.
The President of this Association is one HU LI FOU
( ), age 52 years, native of Kiangpei.
This Association has a book-keeping department, a
correspondence bureau and a secretariat. Eighty employees
have been engaged. Two armed Japanese soldiers are on duty
at the door.
The organisation of a Police Force is being proceeded with.
The Chief of Police is one ZANG GNO TSING ( ), native of
Kiangpei, who is the proprietor of the Dah Kueu Yueu Bath House,
260 Sinsu Road. The Police is comprised of two branches : a
traffic branch and an investigation department. In charge of
the Traffic Office is one ZENG ZENG KIE ( ), alias FI
LONG AH KENG ( ), former proprietor of the Fi Long Garage,
Chekiang Road, a naturalised Portuguese. The Chief of the
Investigation Bureau, which is staffed with four detectives, is
one Yao Tze Zeu ( ), alias AH SENG ( ), who was
formerly a detective in the International Settlement Police.
Each detective is paid 35 to 40 dollars. There are about twenty
constables in the Police Force. They wear khaki uniform. The
pay of each constable has been fixed at 18 dollars. At present
these constables are on the premises of the Association and will
be posted in the streets of Chapei, as soon as the preparations
of the Organisation are completed. In addition to keeping order
in the streets they have to serve as interpreters between
Chinese and Japanese.
According to the President of this Independent
Municipality, the strength of the Force will be increased to
2,000, with the least possible delay.
The inhabitants may not remove: Those who desire to
transport goods must first notify the "Municipality", which
estimates the value of the goods and issues a pass. A tax of
2/1000 of the value of the goods is collected.
Owners of boats and vehicles of all kinds are called
upon to pay a tax to the said Municipality from April 1.
Notices announcing the date of the operation of the
Association in question were pasted up in the roads on April 4.
On April 6 the "Association for the Maintenance of the
Situation at Chapei" signed on some fifty coolies for the
cleaning of the streets.
These coolies, as well as the other employees of the
"Municipality" are provided with a rectangular badge, bearing
the following characters ( ), translation of which is
"Association for the Maintenance of the Situation in Chapei".
The Japanese Authorities, moreover, published the
following official statement :-
The Japanese Authorities have never sought to set up, nor
given assistance to set up a political or administrative form
of government whatever, at Chapei. The Japanese occupation has
confined itself to military necessities, at the same time
considering it desirable that the Police be reorganised, in
order to ensure that order and the circulation of the traffic
be maintained.
Furthermore, as negotiations are in progress, for the
cessation of Sino-Japanese hostilities, the Japanese Authorities
have, up to the present, been content to await the results of
the negotiations, while keeping the situation under observation.
However, they have never seen, and do not now see, the
necessity to obstruct an organisation movement attempted by
bona fide Chinese personalities.

（批：Jule 8.4.32）

编号 D 3445
1932年4月7日法国报告的译文
日期 1932年4月21日

闸北已组织起一个维持现状的协会。

一个名为“维持闸北局势协会”的独立市政府正在日本当局的赞助下组建，办公地点位于闸北敏利路66号（Min Lih Lou），此处原为大上海财政局的征税办公室。
该协会会长为胡立夫（HU LI FOU）（音译），52岁，江北人。
该协会设有会计科、通信局和秘书处。已雇佣80名员工。门口有两名持枪日本士兵执勤。
警察部队的组建工作正在进行中。警察局长为臧诺清（ZANG GNO TSING）（音译），江北人，是新修路260号大观园浴室（Dah Kueu Yueu Bath House）的老板。警察部队由两个分支组成：交通科和调查科。交通办公室主任为曾增杰（ZENG ZENG KIE）（音译），别名飞龙阿根（FI LONG AH KENG）（音译），浙江路飞龙车行前老板，归化葡萄牙籍。调查局局长由姚子周（Yao Tze Zeu）（音译）担任，别名阿松（AH SENG）（音译），曾任国际租界警务处侦探。调查局配有四名侦探，每名侦探薪金为35至40元。警察部队约有二十名巡捕。他们身穿卡其色制服。每名巡捕的薪金定为18元。目前这些巡捕在协会驻地，一旦组织准备工作完成，将被部署到闸北街头。除了维持街道秩序外，他们还必须担任中日之间的翻译。
据这位独立市政府会长称，警力将尽快增加至2000人。
居民不得随意搬离物品：那些希望运输货物的人必须首先通知“市政府”，由其对货物价值进行评估并发放通行证。征收货物价值千分之二的税款。
各类船只和车辆的所有者被要求自4月1日起向该“市政府”缴纳税款。
宣布该协会运作日期的告示已于4月4日张贴在道路上。
4月6日，“维持闸北局势协会”签约雇佣了约50名苦力清扫街道。
这些苦力以及“市政府”的其他雇员均配发一枚长方形徽章，上面刻有以下字符（原文不清），译为“维持闸北局势协会”。
此外，日本当局发表了以下官方声明：
日本当局从未寻求在闸北建立任何形式的政治或行政政府，也未提供协助。日本的占领仅限于军事需要，同时认为重组警察部队是可取的，以确保维持秩序和交通畅通。
此外，由于中日敌对行动停止的谈判正在进行中，日本当局迄今为止一直满足于等待谈判结果，同时观察局势。然而，他们过去没有，现在也不认为有必要阻碍由真诚的中国人士尝试组织的运动。

（批注：Jule 1932年4月8日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 9445. S.D. 4. Section 8. 4. 32. Date: April 18. 1932.）

Subject (in full) Inauguration in Chapei of a Citizens' Maintenance Association.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt

The Shanghai Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association with an office at 66 Ming Li Road, Chapei, which was inaugurated on April 1, 1932, now employs 24 policemen (unarmed) and 130 road cleaners at a flat rate of 50 cents each per day and 30 so-called male and about 10 female investigators without pay. The 24 policemen are now guarding the office, while the 130 road cleaners are attending to the work of clearing the streets of garbage. Four female investigators are posted at the north end of Markham Road bridge to assist the Japanese marines posted there in searching Chinese female pedestrians, while the 30 males are posted at the entrance to various streets in Chapei for the purpose of checking up on persons entering Chapei or removing belongings or goods without the special permit issued by the Association. These permits are issued to any applicants on payment of 1% of the value of the belonging or goods to be removed.

The congee station at Kiaotung Road, formerly belonging to the Chapei Benevolent Institutions, was reopened by the Association on April 7, when about 300 poor people were given meals.

About 25% of the small shops in the former 4th District west of Kung Woo Sing Road have resumed business, but close about 5 p.m. every day.

Some 500 public rickshas bearing the old licence plates of the Shanghai Municipality are operating in the district.

The following is a list of persons officiating in the new association together with a summary of their antecedents:-

主题（全称）：闸北市民维持会的成立。

由谭绍良（Tan Shao-liang）巡官呈报，经托马斯·罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）巡官转递

上海北区市民维持会办公地点位于闸北明利路66号，于1932年4月1日成立，目前雇佣24名警察（无武装）和130名道路清洁工，每人每日固定工资50分，另有30名所谓男性调查员和约10名女性调查员，无薪。这24名警察目前守卫着办公室，而130名道路清洁工负责清理街道垃圾。4名女性调查员部署在麦高包路（Markham Road）桥北端，协助驻扎在那里的日本海军陆战队搜查中国女性行人，而30名男性调查员则部署在闸北各街道入口，目的是检查进入闸北的人员或在没有协会颁发的特别许可证的情况下搬运财物或货物的人员。这些许可证发给任何申请人，条件是缴纳拟搬走财物或货物价值的1%。

位于胶州路（Kiaotung Road）的粥厂，原属闸北慈善机构，由该协会于4月7日重新开放，当时约有300名穷人得到了膳食。

以前第四区工务星路（Kung Woo Sing Road）以西的小商店中，约有25%已恢复营业，但每天下午5点左右关门。

区内约有500辆公共人力车在运营，车上挂有上海工部局的旧牌照。

April 8, 1935.

Inauguration in Chapei of a Citizens' Maintenance Association

The Shanghai Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association with an office at 69 Ming Li Road, Chapei, which was inaugurated on April 1, 1932, now employs 24 policemen (unarmed) and 130 road cleaners at a flat rate of 50 cents each per day and 30 so-called male and about 10 female investigators without pay. The 24 policemen are now guarding the office, while the 130 road cleaners are attending to the work of clearing the streets of garbage. Four female investigators are posted at the north end of Markham Road Bridge to assist the Japanese marines posted there in searching Chinese female pedestrians, while the 30 males are posted at the entrance to various streets in Chapei for the purpose of checking up on persons entering Chapei or removing belongings or goods without the special permit issued by the Association. These permits are issued to any applicants on payment of 1% of the value of the belonging or goods to be removed.

The congee station at Kiaotung Road, formerly belonging to the Chapei Benevolent Institutions, was reopened by the Association on April 7, when about 300 poor people were given meals.

About 25% of the small shops in the former 4th District west of Kung Wee Sing Road have resumed business, but close about 5 p.m. every day.

Some 500 public rickshas bearing the old license plates of the Shanghai Municipality are operating in the district.

The following is a list of persons officiating in the new association together with a summary of their antecedents:-

1. Chief of Administration Wu Lih-fu, (胡立夫), native of Anhui; age about 45, is a close friend of Chen Ah Kung (程阿根) or Fee Lung Ah Kung (飛龍阿根), a notorious opium smuggler

闸北市民维持会的成立

上海北区市民维持会办公室设在闸北明理路69号，该会于1932年4月1日成立，目前雇佣24名警察（无武装）和130名清道夫，每人每天固定工资5角，另有30名所谓的男性调查员和约10名女性调查员，无薪。这24名警察目前负责守卫办公室，而130名清道夫负责清理街道垃圾的工作。4名女性调查员部署在马克姆路桥（Markham Road Bridge，今浙江北路桥）北端，协助驻扎在那里的日本海军陆战队搜查中国女性行人，而30名男性调查员则部署在闸北各街道入口，目的是检查进入闸北的人员，或查处未经该会签发的特别许可证而搬运财物或货物的行为。这些许可证发给任何申请人，条件是缴纳拟搬出财物或货物价值的1%。

位于胶东路（Kiaotung Road，今吉林路）的粥厂，原属闸北慈善机构，由该会于4月7日重新开放，当时约有300名穷人获得餐食。

公卫兴路（Kung Wee Sing Road，今公共卫生路或类似道路，音译）以西原第四区的小商店约有25%恢复营业，但每天下午5点左右关门。

区内约有500辆挂有上海市政当局旧牌照的公共黄包车在运营。

Copy of a General Report dated 7/4/32
.......

A further visit was paid to the offices of the
Shanghai Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association,
Ming Lik Road, Chapei, on April 6, 1932.

Whilst passing through various roads en route to
the offices, posters were noticed affixed to the shutters
of shops and purporting to have been issued by the Shanghai
Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association,
calling upon the public to return to their homes and/or
places of business and resume residence in Chapei, further
that owing to the lawlessness obtaining in that district
as a result of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, a committee
of citizens had been formed with one Hu Li Fu (胡立夫)
as Chief and Huang Doo (汪度) as his assistants to
combat the lawless element and make the district fit for
residence.

The Association is now issuing permits for people
to return to their homes and/or places of business for
the purpose of removing their effects. It was explained
to the undersigned, that these permits are charged for
at the rate of $2.00, which fee is devoted to the upkeep
of the office, and the payment of the wages of the staff.
This source of income is the sole one according to the
informant Ngien Tung-yuen, Chief of the Social Section,
who averred that the Japanese had so far not rendered
any monetary assistance, although they were cognisant of
the association's existence, having been primarily responsible
for its inception.

In the opinion of the undersigned, it is rather
early in the day to positively state what line this
association means to take. However, seeing that the
majority, if not all, of the persons in office are of
Kompe loafer class, it is inconceivable that their
administration can produce any relief for the ex-population
of the Chapei Area.
(D. S. Golder).

1932年4月7日总报告副本
.......

1932年4月6日，再次走访了位于闸北明立路的上海北区市民维持会办事处。

在前往该办事处的途中经过各条道路时，注意到商店的百叶窗上张贴着海报，声称由上海北区市民维持会发布，呼吁公众返回家园和/或营业场所，恢复在闸北的居住；此外，由于中日敌对行动导致该地区无法无天，已成立一个市民委员会，由胡立夫担任主任，汪度担任其助手，以打击不法之徒，使该地区适宜居住。

该协会目前正在签发许可证，允许人们返回家园和/或营业场所以搬走财物。据向签署人解释，这些许可证的收费标准为2.00元，该费用用于维持办公室运作及支付员工工资。据社会科科长严东园（音译）称，这是唯一的收入来源；他断言，尽管日本人对该协会的存在知情，且对该协会的发起负有主要责任，但迄今为止未提供任何金钱援助。

在签署人看来，现在就明确断定该协会将采取何种方针还为时过早。然而，鉴于任职者中大多数（如果不是全部的话）都属于青帮流氓阶层，难以想象他们的管理能为闸北地区的前居民带来任何救济。
(D. S. Golder).

闸北市民维持会的成立

上海北区市民维持会办事处位于闸北明立路69号，该会于1932年4月1日成立，目前雇佣24名警察（无武装）和130名清道夫，每人每天固定工资50分；另有30名所谓男性调查员和约10名女性调查员，无薪。这24名警察目前负责守卫办公室，而130名清道夫则负责清理街道垃圾。4名女性调查员被部署在马克姆路（Markham Road，今海宁路）桥北端，协助驻扎在那里的日本海军陆战队搜查中国女性行人；而30名男性调查员则被部署在闸北各街道入口，目的是检查进入闸北的人员，或查处在没有该协会签发的特别许可证的情况下搬运财物或货物的行为。这些许可证发给任何申请人，收费标准为拟搬运财物或货物价值的1%。

位于胶东路（Kiaotung Road，今吉林路）的粥厂，原属闸北慈善机构，由该协会于4月7日重新开放，当时约有300名穷人获得了餐食。

以前第四区工务星路（Kung Woo Sing Road，今公兴路）以西的小店铺中，约有25%已恢复营业，但每天下午5点左右关门。

区内约有500辆公共人力车挂着上海市政当局旧的牌照在运营。

以下是新协会任职人员名单及其背景摘要：-

1. 行政科长吴立夫（胡立夫），安徽人，年龄约45岁，是著名鸦片走私贩程阿根或飞龙阿根的密友

page_data.en:
- ,2 -

and was formerly the proprietor of a leather manufacture in
Ferry Road. Started life as a lawyers tout he owns shares
in the Wu Long (五龍) Bath House, 522 Nanking Road, and is
reported to be living at 105 Ching Loh Lee (錦樂里), Wei
Hai Wei Road. He is also said to be an associate of Japanese
undesirables in Hongkew who earn a living in smuggling morphia,
etc. Apart from his connection in the bath house, Wu does
not appear to be engaged in legitimate business.
2. Chief of Police Chang Yu Tsing (常玉清), age about 40,
native of Kempo, was formerly a wharf coolie in Shanghai.
He owns the Ta Kuan Yuen (大觀園) Bath House, Thibet Road
and Avenue Road corner, is known as a Lau Du Ts (loafer head)
and has a number of tufei followers. He at one time owned
a theatre in Foochow Road and was arrested by Bubbling Well
Police some years ago in connection with a threatening letter
case. He is now a member of the Committee of the Kompe
Provincial Association and is on friendly terms with Koo Ss
(顧少), a theatre proprietor and one of the most prominent
leafer leaders in Shanghai. He is also on the Committee of
the Unemployed Wharf Coolies' Relief Association.
3. Chief Detective Yau Ts Too (姚志圖), alias Yau Ah Sung
(姚阿生), a native of Kempe, age about 40, joined the
Shanghai Municipal Police as constable on 12/7/07, and was
later appointed to the C.I.D. His services were terminated
on February 9, 1928, owing to suspicion of his having become
an associate of criminal elements. In April 1929, a warrant
was issued for his arrest on a charge of being an associate of
armed robbers and is still on file at the Shanghai Special
District Court.
4. Traffic Superintendent Chen Heng Ching (程享品), alias
Chen Ah Rong (陳阿榕), alias Fee Leng Ah Kung (費冷阿公),
native of Ningpo, age about 45, started life as chauffeur.
page_data.zh:
- ,2 -

曾任斐伦路（Ferry Road，今复兴东路）一家皮革制造厂的老板。早年做过律师掮客，拥有南京路522号五龙浴室的股份，据报住在威海卫路锦乐里105号。据说他还与虹口一些靠走私吗啡等为生的日本不良分子有勾结。除了与浴室的关系外，吴似乎并未从事正当生意。
2. 警务科长常玉清，年龄约40岁，江北人，曾是上海的码头苦力。他拥有西藏路与爱文义路（Avenue Road，今北京西路）转角的大观园浴室，被称为“流氓头子”，并有一群土匪追随者。他曾在福州路拥有一家戏院，几年前因一起恐吓信案件被静安寺捕房逮捕。他目前是江北同乡会委员会成员，并与戏院老板、上海最突出的流氓领袖之一顾少（顾竹轩）关系友好。他也是失业码头苦力救济协会委员会成员。
3. 侦探长姚志图，别名姚阿生，江北人，年龄约40岁，于1907年7月12日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处任巡捕，后调入刑事侦缉处。1928年2月9日，因涉嫌与犯罪团伙勾结而被终止服务。1929年4月，因被指控与武装抢劫犯勾结而发出逮捕令，该档案仍存于上海特区法院。
4. 交通总监程享品，别名陈阿榕，别名费冷阿公，宁波人，年龄约45岁，早年做过司机。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Between 1920 and 1924 he acquired considerable wealth through
opium smuggling from Liuho to French Concession and subsequently
became proprietor of public hire garages on Hupeh Road, Moulmein
Road and Avenue Edward VII and built houses and a workshop in
Yu Yuen Road. In 1924 or so, General Ho Fung Ling (何豐林),
then Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander, issued a warrant for
his arrest charging him with having committed an armed robbery
of opium in Liu Hang (瀏行), near the motor road. He
disappeared for some time and his garages were all sealed up
by order of Court. The matter was eventually hushed up by
the payment by Zung to the Garrison Commander of a considerable
sum of money. Two of his garages were subsequently closed
and he is now reported to be in financial straits. He is an
associate of loafers of both the International Settlement and
French Concession.

5. Chief of Social Department Kyien Tung Yuen (嚴東園). This
probably refers to a man named Jausen Yen (嚴東園), who
worked for some time as a compositor in the "Shanghai Times"
Subsequently he became interpreter and accountant to a
Chinese lawyer named Ching Li Sung (金立人), No.6 Ying Hwa
Lee (美華里), Rue Millet, French Concession. Ching is a
follower of Huang Ching Yung (黃金榮), one of the leaders
of the opium gang of the French Concession.

6. Chief Inspector of Police Lee Fee (李飛), alias Li Bang Fea
(李鵬飛) alias Tientsin Hyi Pau (天津寶), native of
Tientsin, is a follower of Chi Yuen Ching (季雲卿), a
notorious "Young" leader. Li was formerly a musician in
Singsong Houses. In 1927 he was Chief of Bodyguard to
General Yang Hsiao-tien (楊嘯天) and became one of the
abductors in a Roulette Den, 209 Rue du Consulat, when
General Yang retired. He also gained notoriety in the
smuggling of arms and opium.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

1920年至1924年间，他通过从浏河向法租界走私鸦片积累了大量财富，随后成为湖北路、莫利哀路（Moulmein Road，今南苏州路或附近道路，注：Moulmein Rd通常指莫利哀路，即今南苏州路一段或老靶子路附近，此处依原文音译或惯例处理，但结合上下文车库位置，可能指具体路段）和爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII，今延安东路）上的公共租车行的老板，并在豫园路（Yu Yuen Road，今邑庙路或附近）建造了房屋和车间。1924年左右，时任吴淞-上海守备司令的何丰林将军签发逮捕令，指控他在公路附近的浏行实施了武装抢劫鸦片案。他失踪了一段时间，他的所有车行均被法院命令查封。此事最终通过向守备司令支付一大笔钱而得以平息。随后他的两家车行关闭，据报他目前陷入财务困境。他是国际租界和法租界流氓的同伙。

5. 社会科科长严东园。这可能指的是一个叫严东园的人，他曾在《字林西报》（Shanghai Times，注：原文为Shanghai Times，通常指《字林西报》North China Daily News的晚报版或相关刊物，此处直译）做了一段时间的排字工。后来，他成为法租界米勒路（Rue Millet，今虎丘路或附近，注：Rue Millet通常译为米勒路，即今江西南路或虎丘路一带，需根据具体历史地图确认，此处保留路名音译或通用译名，法租界Rue Millet为敏体尼荫路? 不，Rue Millet是米勒路，今江西南路部分或淮海中路? 经查Rue Millet为法租界米勒路，今江西南路近延安东路段，或者可能是其他路。此处按常见译法或保留）美华里6号的中国律师金立人的翻译和会计。金是法租界鸦片帮派领袖之一黄金荣的追随者。

6. 警务督察长李飞，别名李鹏飞，别名天津宝，天津人，是著名“青帮”领袖季云卿的追随者。李曾是歌厅的音乐师。1927年，他是杨啸天将军的保镖队长，在杨将军退休后，成为领事馆路（Rue du Consulat，今金陵东路）209号轮盘赌窟绑架案的绑匪之一。他在武器和鸦片走私方面也臭名昭著。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

7. Chief of General Affairs Section Huang Tu (汪度), native
of Kompo. Not much is known about this man who is to have
been a clerk in the Yokohama Specie Bank and speaks Japanese.
The following is a list of persons who are reported
to be behind the establishment of the new Association:-
1. Koo Sz (顾四), alias Koo Tso-sien (顾竹轩), alias Koo
Su-Now. He is a native of Kompo, age about 50, proprietor
of the Tian Zian Wu Tai (天蟾舞台) Theatre, Foochow Road
and follower of Hwang Ching Yung, notorious "Paung" leader
of the French Concession. Koo started life as a ricsha
coolie and subsequently joined the Shanghai Municipal
Police as a constable. He was dismissed for misconduct.
He was once arrested in connection with a murder on
Foochow Road but was released owing to insufficient evidence.
2. Koo Sai (顾三), alias Koo Sung Now (顾松茂) brother of
Koo Sz, a foreman in the Star Ricsha Company, was formerly
a ricsha coolie. He is proprietor of a Kompo theatre in
Chapel and a notorious loafer.
3. Wei Chung Sau (韦钟秀), a native of Kompo, formerly
Chief Detective of the Public Safety Bureau, is a follower
of Doe Yuet-sung and the French Concession Opium Gang.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

7. 总务科科长汪度，江北人。关于此人的情况知之甚少，据说他曾在横滨正金银行做过职员，会说日语。
以下是据报在幕后支持建立新协会的人员名单：-
1. 顾四，别名顾竹轩，别名顾松茂。他是江北人，年龄约50岁，福州路天蟾舞台的老板，也是法租界著名“胖”（Paung，疑为Pang或帮会头目绰号）领袖黄金荣的追随者。顾早年做过人力车夫，随后加入上海公共租界工部局警务处任巡捕。他因行为不端被开除。他曾因福州路的一起谋杀案被捕，但因证据不足被释放。
2. 顾三，别名顾松茂，顾四的兄弟，星辉人力车公司的工头，曾做过人力车夫。他是闸北一家江北戏院的老板，也是著名的流氓。
3. 韦钟秀，江北人，前公安局侦探长，是杜月笙和法租界鸦片帮派的追随者。

Copy of a General Report dated 7/4/32
.......

A further visit was paid to the offices of the
Shanghai Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association,
Ming Lih Road, Chapei, on April 6, 1932.

Whilst passing through various roads en route to
the offices, posters were noticed affixed to the shutters
of shops and purporting to have been issued by the Shanghai
Northern District Citizens' Maintenance Association,
calling upon the public to return to their homes and/or
places of business and resume residence in Chapei, further
that owing to the lawlessness obtaining in that district
as a result of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, a committee
of citizens had been formed with one Hu Li Fu (胡立夫)
as Chief and Huang Doo (汪度 ) as his assistants to
combat the lawless element and make the district fit for
residence.

The Association is now issuing permits for people
to return to their homes and/or places of business for
the purpose of removing their effects. It was explained
to the undersigned, that these permits are charged for
at the rate of $2.00, which fee is devoted to the upkeep
of the office, and the payment of the wages of the staff.
This source of income is the sole one according to the
informant Egien Tung-yuen, Chief of the Social Section,
who averred that the Japanese had so far not rendered
any monetary assistance, although they were cognisant of
the association's existence, having been primarily responsible
for its inception.

In the opinion of the undersigned, it is rather
early in the day to positively state what line this
association mean/to take. However, seeing that the
majority, if not all, of the persons in office are of
Kuang loafer class, it is inconceivable that their
administration can produce any relief for the ex-population
of the Chapei Area.

1932年4月7日总报告副本
.......

1932年4月6日，再次走访了位于闸北明立路的上海北区市民维持会办事处。

在前往该办事处的途中经过各条道路时，注意到商店的百叶窗上张贴着海报，声称由上海北区市民维持会发布，呼吁公众返回家园和/或营业场所，恢复在闸北的居住；此外，由于中日敌对行动导致该地区无法无天，已成立一个市民委员会，由胡立夫担任主任，汪度担任其助手，以打击不法之徒，使该地区适宜居住。

该协会目前正在签发许可证，允许人们返回家园和/或营业场所以搬走财物。据向签署人解释，这些许可证的收费标准为2.00元，该费用用于维持办公室运作及支付员工工资。据社会科科长严东园（音译）称，这是唯一的收入来源；他断言，尽管日本人对该协会的存在知情，且对该协会的发起负有主要责任，但迄今为止未提供任何金钱援助。

在签署人看来，现在就明确断定该协会将采取何种方针还为时过早。然而，鉴于任职者中大多数（如果不是全部的话）都属于广帮（Kuang，疑为Guang或特定帮派称呼，原文如此）流氓阶层，难以想象他们的管理能为闸北地区的前居民带来任何救济。

[Signature]

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

THE POLITICAL ORGAN IN CHAPEI : ARREST OF CHINESE OFFICERS
ORDERED.

The Municipality of Greater Shanghai yesterday issued
the following order to the Public Safety Bureau :-
"Chinese undesirables in Chapei, in conspiracy with
certain foreigners, inaugurated a Chapei District Citizens
Maintenance Association on April 1. Its office is located
in the Police Revenue Bureau on Ming Lih Road. The Association
commenced the collection of taxes on April 1. A Chinese
named Wu Lih Fu, a native of Anhwei, residing at No. 105 Kyung
Loh Li alleyway off Weihaiwei Rd is Chief of the Chapei District
Citizens Peace Maintenance Association with Wang Doo as Deputy-
Chief; Zeng Ngch Tsing is the Chief of the Police Department;
Zung Hsi Ts Chief of the Traffic Department; Yao Wu Chief
Detective Officer; Li Eac Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.
All these undesirables should be dealt with seriously severely.
You are instructed to make investigations and to arrest these
undesirables."
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai yesterday issued
the following proclamation :-
"In connection with the illegal organization of the
socalled Chapei District Citizens Peace Maintenance Association
by Wu Lih Fu, etc., in conspiracy with certain foreigners, we
have already instructed the Public Safety Bureau to make an
investigation and to arrest the Chinese undesirables. We
will not recognize any of the activities carried out by this
illegal organization. This proclamation is issued for
public information."

A Denial.

Koo Tso Hsen (proprietor of the Tien Zoen Wu Tae
Theatre) publishes an advertisement in the Sin Wen Pao and
other local newspapers announcing that the report published
by the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury to the effect that he
is connected with the political organization in Chapei is
untrue and that he has asked the paper to make correction.
The advertisement is published for the information of the
public.

闸北的政治组织：下令逮捕中国官员。

大上海市政府昨日向公安局发出如下命令：-
“闸北的不良分子与某些外国人勾结，于4月1日成立了‘闸北区市民维持会’。其办事处位于明立路警察捐务处内。该协会于4月1日开始征税。一名叫吴立夫（Wu Lih Fu）的中国人，安徽籍，居住在威海卫路京洛里弄堂105号，任‘闸北区市民和平维持会’会长，王度（Wang Doo）任副会长；曾玉清（Zeng Ngch Tsing）任警务科科长；程希之（Zung Hsi Ts）任交通科科长；姚五（Yao Wu）任总探长；李飞（Li Eac）任公安局长。所有这些不良分子都应受到严厉惩处。现指令你们进行调查并逮捕这些不良分子。”
大上海市政府昨日发布如下公告：-
“关于吴立夫等人与某些外国人勾结非法组织所谓‘闸北区市民和平维持会’一事，我局已指令公安局进行调查并逮捕这些中国不良分子。我们将不承认该非法组织开展的任何活动。特此公告，以资周知。”

否认声明。

顾佐贤（Koo Tso Hsen，天恩舞台业主）在《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登广告，宣布《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）报道他与闸北政治组织有关联一事不实，并已要求该报更正。刊登此广告旨在告知公众。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 9445.）

Subject (in full) Administrative Organ in Chapei - Chinese
Authorities order arrest of its members.
Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by J.W. Robertson, Supt.

On April 6, the Chinese Municipality issued an
order to the Public Safety Bureau to effect the arrest of
Wu Lih Fu (胡立夫), who is described as a native of
(夏黄里)
Anhui, living at 105 Ching Loh Chung, Weihaiwei Road, who
is the Chief of the New Administrative Office in Chapei,
Wong Doo (王度), the Deputy Chief, Zang Yu-ching (常玉清),
the Chief of Police, Zung Hsi Sz (程希之) (? Zung Ah Kung
(程阿根)), the Traffic Superintendent, Yau Wu (姚五),
(Yau Ah Sung (姚阿生), the Chief Detective and Li Fee (李飛),
the Chief Inspector of Police.

The Public Safety Bureau has also received
information that Koo Sung Mow (顧松茂), a foreman of the
Star Ricsha Company and brother of Koo Sz (顧四), the
notorious theatre master, is really financing the
Administrative Office, and that Koo Sz is really behind the
movement.

One of the incomes to be derived for the upkeep of
the Office is to levy charges for the issue of permits for
removal of personal effects from Chapei, but the promoters
aim at the running of opium and gambling when conditions
become normal.

Tan Shaoliang

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / N°. D 745 Station, / Date April 6 / 1932）

Subject (in full) Bomb Explosion in the French Concession.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by H.W Robertson, Supt

A bomb was thrown over the wall into the compound of
No. 3 Ching Yi Lee (均益里), Rue Amiral Bayle, French
Concession, about 8 p.m. April 4. An explosion, which
resulted, damaged the wall of the compound and inflicted
bruises on the arms of the occupier named Wong Ts Liang
(王子良) who was entering the house at the time.
Wong was intelligence officer to General Dung Chen
Zien (陈振全), the Commander of the Woosung Forts, who
fled when the Japanese attack on that fortress started.
While occupying this post Wong engaged extensively in
opium smuggling and in this way gained considerable notoriety.
Wong's assistants at Woosung included one Koo Chia Tsai (顾嘉才)
an ex-C.D.C. of the Municipal Police. Both Wong and Koo
are reported to have joined the new administration established
in Chapei under Japanese guidance.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

主题（全称） 法租界炸弹爆炸事件。

呈报人 谭绍良总监 转呈人 H.W Robertson 总监

4月4日晚8时许，一枚炸弹被扔过围墙，落入法租界贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）均益里（Ching Yi Lee）3号的院内。爆炸导致院墙受损，并使当时正进入屋内的住户王子良（Wong Ts Liang）手臂挫伤。
王曾是吴淞要塞司令陈振全将军（General Dung Chen Zien）的情报官，当日军开始攻击该要塞时，陈逃跑了。王在担任此职期间，广泛从事鸦片走私，并因此声名狼藉。
王在吴淞的助手包括一名叫顾嘉才（Koo Chia Tsai）的人，他是工部局警务处的前便衣侦探（C.D.C.）。据报道，王和顾都加入了在日本指导下于闸北建立的新行政机构。

Bubblingwell Station, S. B. REGISTRY.
April 5, 1932. No. D 3445.
Local Intelligence. to 6. / 4. / 32.

Refugees
None entered the Settlement, but a number observed
returning to countryside.

Refugee Camps
No agitation. Numbers decreasing steadily.

Shops
Normal.

Creek Traffic
90% of normal volume entered Settlement via Soochow
Creek on the 4-4-32.

Industrial Situation
No change.

Rumoured Hostilities
Gardeners etc. coming into Shanghai state that continu-
ous gunfire was heard during the night of the 3/4-4-32, from
the direction of Tsze Ka Jau, near Tai-chong Hsien.

Rumoured Change of Administration in Chapei
On the 4-4-32 detectives observed Japanese Marines on
guard over a proclamation posted on the North side of Markham
Road Bridge. Pedestrians entering the Settlement supplied
information to the effect that the proclamation purported to
emanate from the Chairman named Woo of the "Chapei Maintenance
Society", and sets forth that a monthly tax of $8.00 will be
collected by the Japanese from all street traders operating in
Chapei. Further, that a Police Department is being
formed (there are no B.P.S. men there now) with one Yau Te Doo
(姚子都) or Yau Ah Sung (姚阿生) ex C.D.S.I. (S.M.P) as Supt. of
Detectives, and one Zang Nyoh Tsing (常玉清), once charged from
Bubblingwell on a Threatening Letter case, as Officer i/c Police
Department.
As everyone crossing into Chapei were being searched, the C.D.C.
was unable to approach and confirm the information.

（左侧手写批注：Of information this type local staff can afford scant attention & the during Japanese hostilities antecedent they may give rise to quite false reports. 9/4）

正常。

1932年4月4日，通过苏州河进入租界的交通量为正常水平的90%。

工业状况
无变化。

传闻的战事
进入上海的园丁等人称，1932年4月3日至4日夜间，听到太仓县附近曹家渡（Tsze Ka Jau）方向传来连续的枪声。

传闻闸北行政变更
1932年4月4日，侦探观察到日本海军陆战队士兵在马克姆路（Markham Road）桥北侧张贴的公告旁站岗。进入租界的行人提供信息称，该公告 purportedly 出自“闸北维持会”主席吴氏之手，并规定日本方面将向在闸北经营的所有街头商贩每月征收8.00元的税款。此外，正在组建一个警务部门（目前那里没有华捕），由前工部局警务处刑事侦缉股（C.D.S.I.）探员姚子都（Yau Te Doo）或姚阿生（Yau Ah Sung）任探长，由曾因恐吓信案件在静安寺巡捕房被指控过的常玉清（Zang Nyoh Tsing）任警务部门负责人。
由于所有穿越进入闸北的人都在接受搜查，便衣侦探（C.D.C.）无法靠近以确认该信息。

（左侧手写批注：对于此类情报，本地职员几乎不予关注，且在日军敌对行动期间，他们可能会产生完全虚假的报告。4月9日）
