(Sheet 2)

Illegal Functioning B.P.S.

At 3.40p.m. the 4-4-32 a Prison Van belonging to the
B.P.S. with 5 members of the B.P.S. inside was found to be
operating on Yu Yuen Road. The occupants stated that they were
searching for a "rebel" named Doo Tien Ih, who was supposed to
be living at No. 11 Whing Yuen Li, Yu Yuen Road. (This is the man
whom the Special Branch attempted to arrest at the Burlington
Hotel on the 31-3-32). On instructions of the D.O. "B"
the van and occupants were escorted to the 6th. Division B.P.S.
(Zau Ka Doo).

Japanese Military Proclamations

At 5.30p.m. the 4-4-32 a Japanese military patrol was
observed posting proclamations in Chinese on the side of Chinese
houses on Rubicon Road near Brenan Road. Translation, "The
Japanese soldiers are friends of Shanghai citizens. We deny
Chinese soldiers the right to stop in Shanghai."

Slogans

The following slogans were found chalked on walls of
Avenue Road, between Carter and Medhurst Road, at 10.20p.m. the
4-4-32. In English and Chinese; "Support Soviet China", "Join
the Red Army". Washed off.

华捕非法执勤

1932年4月4日下午3点40分，发现一辆属于华捕（B.P.S.）的囚车，车内有5名华捕，在愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）上行驶。车内人员称，他们正在搜寻一名名叫杜天义（Doo Tien Ih）的“反叛分子”，据说他居住在愚园路宏源里11号。（此人即特别处于1932年3月31日试图在奔宁酒店逮捕的那名男子）。根据“B”区警官的指令，该囚车及车内人员被护送至华捕第六分局（曹家渡）。

日本军方公告

1932年4月4日下午5点30分，观察到日本军方巡逻队在靠近布伦南路（Brenan Road）的卢比孔路（Rubicon Road）中国房屋侧面张贴中文公告。译文：“日本士兵是上海市民的朋友。我们否认中国士兵在上海停留的权利。”

标语

1932年4月4日晚上10点20分，在卡特路（Carter Road）和麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）之间的爱文义路（Avenue Road）墙壁上发现用粉笔书写的以下标语。中英文均有：“拥护苏维埃中国”，“参加红军”。已被洗去。

Date April 5. 1932.

Subject (in full) Administration of Chapei Area.

Made by D.S. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

I have to report that enquiries were made in
Chapei this forenoon with reference to the establishment
by the Japanese Authorities of an office from which the
area under Japanese occupation is to be administered, with
the following result.
An association has been formed, styled (The
Shanghai Northern District Citizens' Municipal Maintenance
Association) and has been established in the old District
Office of the Bureau of Finance of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai, Ming Li Road. The object of the
Association is, according to Wu Li Fu (胡立夫) (Chairman
and who is concurrently Chief of the Finance Section)
the management of public affairs. He stated that the
office had been established at the request of and with
the assistance of the Japanese Military Authorities.
(a number of Japanese civilians were observed there, whilst
a Japanese marine was on duty in the court yard).
The members of the Committee and who are con-
currently the chiefs of the departments are as follows:
1. Wu Li Fu (胡立夫), proprietor of the Wu Loong Bath
House, 522 Nanking Road, residing at 105A Weihaiwei
Road, (S.M.P. pistol Licence No.1564) appears to be
well connected, admits that he learned the leather
business in Japan.
2. Zang Ngoh Tsing (岑玉清), Chief of Police Section,
proprietor of the Ta Kuan Bath House, Tibet Road,
native of Kompo, known locally as a loafer.
3. Yau Tsu Wan (姚志遠, alias Yau Ah Sung (姚阿生),
Chief of Investigation Section, ex-C.D.S.I. of S.M.P.

兹报告，今日上午在闸北就日本当局设立办事处以管理其占领区一事进行了调查，结果如下。
一个名为“上海北区市民市政维持会”的组织已经成立，办公地点设在大上海特别市财政局旧区办事处，位于明理路。据该会主席兼财务科科长胡立夫（Wu Li Fu）称，该会的目的是管理公共事务。他声称，该办事处的设立是应日本军方的要求并在其协助下进行的。（当时观察到数名日本平民在场，且有一名日本海军陆战队员在庭院执勤）。

MERELY A ROUGH TRANSLATION
OF AN ORIGINAL IN JAPANESE

JAPANESE CONSULATE GENERAL
25-1 HANGPOO ROAD, SHANGHAI
APRIL 4, 1932, (MORNING)

COMMUNIQUE (1).

The medical treatment administered by the Japanese
Expeditionary Forces is daily reaping considerable re-
sults.

The Japanese medical station at Paoshan is examin-
ing more than 50 Chinese cases every day, and recently
received a letter of appreciation from the President of
the Paoshan Self-Government Association for its services.
Although medical visit at Tating heretofore had not been
considered, Japanese medical men are now daily visiting
the patients in that area in response, at the outset, to
the urgent request by the Self-Government Association for
medical care of the cases of puerperal fever followed by
others.

A deputation composed of 30 to 40 villagers comes
out daily to the outskirts of the town to welcome and send
off these medical men, whose valuable services are highly
appreciated.

日本驻上海总领事馆
上海虹口路25-1号
1932年4月4日，（上午）

公报（1）。

日本远征军提供的医疗救治每日均取得显著成效。

日军在宝山的医疗站每天诊治50多名中国病例，最近还收到了宝山自治会会长对其服务的感谢信。虽然此前并未考虑前往大场进行医疗巡诊，但应自治会起初对产褥热病例及其他病例医疗护理的迫切请求，日本医生现在每天都前往该地区探视病人。

每天有三四十名村民组成的代表团来到市镇郊外迎送这些医生，他们宝贵的服务受到高度赞赏。

    A new Municipal Administrative organ has been established

at a foreign style building in Ming Li Road (the former
office of the Chapei Branch of Finance Bureau).
    Wu Li-fu (胡立夫), the proprietor of the Wu Loong

Officer. The Police has a strength of 150 men and 50
detectives.

on Mongol Road and exhibited there day and night on April
4 without giving him food or water.

Tan Shaoliang

page_data.en:
April 5, 1932. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:
Sin Wan Pao:
CHAPEI POLITICAL AFFAIRS BUREAU FORMED BY TRAITORS.
After the occupation of Chapei, certain Chinese traitors, on the instructions of the Japanese Army, have formed a political organ in Chapei.
On March 24 last the Japanese army engaged a number of Chinese coolies to sweep the streets from the south of the North Station and to the north of the Soochow Creek, the work being carried out under the supervision of traitors. Every coolie engaged is paid 50 cents a day. The Chapei Office of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai on Min Lih Road has been occupied by the Japanese. Two Japanese troops have been posted for duty in front of the office. Eight Chinese traitors are now working with the Japanese.
At 8 a.m. April 1 eight motor cars conveying a number of Chinese called at the office where they remained until noon. They called again at 3 p.m. and left at 5 p.m. All the traitors assumed office on April 1.
The political organ formed yesterday (?) has been given the name of the "Great Japan New Political Affairs Bureau". Ho Lih Fu 胡立夫 is the Chief of the Bureau with Waung Doo 汪度 (an employee of a Japanese bank) as Deputy Chief. The Bureau has a Police Department, a Transport Department and a Public Safety Bureau. A man named Zang 詹 has been engaged as Chief of Police, another man named Yung 程 as Chief of the Transport Department. One Lee 李 has been appointed as Chief of the Public Safety Bureau with a man named Yau 姚 as Chief Detective Officer. One hundred and fifty policemen have been posted for duty; they wear khaki uniforms. Fifty detectives have been recruited.
Upon receipt of the above report, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has issued a circular order directing that an investigation be made.
(A)

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:
NEW MANAGER OF CHINA MERCHANTS S. N. CO.
Acting on instructions from the Ministry of Communications, Lord Li Kuo Chi, Chairman of the Board of Directors, took over the concurrent post of General Manager of the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company at 10 a.m. April 4.
Chen Fu Mo, Vice-Minister of Communications, has been appointed as Superintendent of the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company, but he has not yet assumed his new post.

（批：Attach to file.）
（右上角手写：d. 3045）
page_data.zh:
1932年4月5日。晨间译件。

杂项：
《新闻报》：
叛徒组建闸北政务局。
闸北被占领后，某些中国叛徒奉日军指令，在闸北组建了一个政治机构。
上月24日，日军雇佣了一批中国苦力清扫从北站以南至苏州河以北的街道，该项工作由叛徒监督进行。每名受雇苦力每日工资为五角。位于敏礼路的大上海市政府闸北办事处已被日军占领。两名日军士兵在该办事处门前站岗。现有八名中国叛徒与日本人共事。
4月1日上午8时，数辆汽车载着若干中国人来到该办事处，他们停留至中午。下午3时他们再次到来，并于下午5时离开。所有叛徒均于4月1日到职。
昨日（？）组建的政治机构命名为“大日本新政事务局”。胡立夫任局长，汪度（某日商银行职员）任副局长。该局下设警务部、交通部及公安局。一名姓詹者被聘为警长，另一名姓程者任交通部长。一名姓李者被任命为公安局长，并有一名姓姚者任首席侦探。一百五十名警察已上岗执勤；他们身着卡其色制服。另招募了五十名侦探。
收到上述报告后，大上海市政府已发布通令，指示进行调查。
(A)

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：
招商局轮船公司新经理。
遵照交通部指令，董事会主席李国杰先生于4月4日上午10时兼任招商局轮船公司总经理一职。
交通部次长陈福黼已被任命为招商局轮船公司督察，但尚未就任新职。

（批：归档。）
